danielle moonstar.first_appearance: Marvel Graphic Novel Vol 1 4: The New Mutants
danielle moonstar.origin: ===Origin=== Danielle Moonstar was a Native American of the Cheyenne Nation. After her mutant powers emerged at puberty, she could not control her ability to create visible images of people's greatest fears. Manifesting the images at unexpected moments alienated her from everyone in her community, except for her parents William and Peg Lonestar, and her grandfather, the chief and shaman Black Eagle. thumb|180px|left One night, Dani created a vision of her parents' deaths, and, shortly thereafter, her parents disappeared during a trip to the mountains. danika hart.name: Danika Hart
danika hart.origin: Danika Hart is a YouTube blogger who attends New York University in Manhattan. After the new Spider-Man got his costume damaged in a battle with a demon, who had defeated the Avengers, Danika published a video where she celebrated the fact the new Spider-Man was "a kid of color." Miles was shown this video by his friend Ganke Lee, but was upset as he didn't want to be known as the "Black Spider-Man." After Spider-Man disappeared, Ganke convinced her to publish a video asking her viewers to warn her if they found out anything about him. Although hesitant at first, she agreed and they spent the night on her perch looking at the sky, while waiting for some news. Danika continued hanging out with Ganke afterwards and they started dating. Since he didn't want to risk her deducing Miles' identity through him, Danika agreed to call him by the fake name of Ned. Unfortunately, Ganke eventually blurted out Miles' name by accident. Danika looked into how much she could make by selling out a superhero's identity, but dropped the idea since she realized she was in love with Ganke, and admitted this to him through a letter.

danika trevani.name: Danika Trevani
danika trevani.origin: Danika Trevani was a member of the mercenary team H.E.A.R.T. and was their markswoman. She and H.E.A.R.T. were hired by the Cypress Hills Community Action Group to go after Daniel Ketch after he was suspected in the disappearance of several children. H.E.A.R.T. chased Ghost Rider into the Morlocks' home of tunnels, but they retreated after encountering X-Factor and learned that the children were taken by the Morlocks in order to protect them. Trevani and H.E.A.R.T. were hired again to attack Ghost Rider by the demon Deathwatch, but they eventually ended their ties with Deathwatch after learning that he was a villain. Trevani and most of H.E.A.R.T. were killed by the Firm after they attacked their headquarters.

danilo rojas.name: Danilo Rojas
danilo rojas.origin: Danilo Rojas was a military officer in the Colombian army. Believing the Terrigen Cloud spread throughout the globe to be a gift from God meant to help man purge Mutants, Rojas and his men began to massacre the sick Mutant population in the country. He disappeared before he could be arrested for his crimes, having stationed at an abandoned military base in Ecuador. thumb|left The Mutant mercenary Domino became aware of Rojas' whereabouts, anonymously leaked an encrypted comm log into the internal network of Bobby Da Costa's A.I.M. so he could find out his location, and subsequently positioned herself in Ecuador so Bobby would contact her to take care of Rojas as a favor. Domino would use the favor to make Bobby forgive a debt of hers. After infiltrating Rojas' facility and killing his forty-two assets, Domino was confronted by Rojas just as she ran out of bullets. Right as Rojas was mocking Domino's predicament, a single bullet from a magazine she had lost earlier during the mission fell from the ventilation system into her gun's chamber, giving her the opportunity to shoot Rojas in the head.

danny bartlett.name: Danny Bartlett
danny bartlett.origin: Danny Bartlett was a small-time crook and all he was looking for in his life was to make a lot of money, sometimes even risking going to prison for a long time for his crimes. One day he met a man who offered him two million dollars if he would agree to marry his beautiful daughter. Initially skeptical, thinking it was a joke, the man, whose name was Ebenezer Wellington, eventually managed to convince him. Danny agreed and he and Wellington agreed on a wedding day and venue, to which he was to appear in suitable attire and with the understanding that he would not see the bride until the wedding day. Once the fateful day arrived, Danny went to the appointed place after having a suitable dress made by a tailor, even if the dress seemed more appropriate for a funeral than a wedding, and once there he was welcomed by Ebenezer alongside his betrothed, who turned out to be a girl embalmed in a coffin, and given the situation Danny asked what would become of the promised 2 million, but Ebenezer replied to him what he would do with the money and that he would never leave that place and immediately plunged a embalming needle in the terrified Danny.

danny bennett.name: Danny Bennett
danny bennett.origin: Danny Bennett's parents were going through a messy divorce and his father, Mitchell Bennett kidnapped him and fled to a cabin in the snowy mountains in Colorado. Mitch planned to flee to California but before he could the cabin was covered by an avalanche. He tried to leave, but the door was covered in snow and Bruce Banner crawled out of it and into the cabin. The trio crawled out of the hole left by Bruce and Mitch made it to the surface. Danny slipped and he and Bruce plunged back into the cabin. Danny fell unconscious but was saved from the cabin by the Hulk and Bruce handed the kid overto the authorities.

danny boland.name: Danny Boland
danny boland.origin: Danny was engaged to Mona and wanted to marry her, not knowing that she was a spirit and that she was resentful of all men after she was jilted by one she loved who broke her heart, took her money, her youth, and her love. Somehow she developed a power to kill her suitors by throwing darts at their photograph which caused internal pain and injury. Danny was a victim of one of her attacks when one of her darts caused him to suffer a heart attack.

danny camino.name: Danny Camino
danny camino.origin: Danny Camino was the son of industrialist Lee Camino, owner of Sterling Motors. Danny discovered from a document that his father had signed a contract with Executive Services, Inc., a company that lent money to industrialists, expecting a percentage of the profits. The contracts had stringent clauses; Camino's clause required him to hand over his son Danny to ESI and have him killed by Headhunter. Camino told his son not to take the clause seriously, but when he became insolvent, Danny was kidnapped. Spider-Man helped Camino, preventing Headhunter from killing him and thus rescuing his son Danny, who was being held prisoner by Headhunter in the ESI basement. Headhunter set traps in ESI's basement, but Spider-Man overcame the traps and knocked Headhunter out with a punch, revealing all the heads Headhunter had decapitated, stored in glass containers. Headhunter was arrested, while the ESI executives fled in a helicopter, dismissing the incident as a simple mishap. Once the ESI crisis was over, Camino began to adopt a softer business strategy, putting the family first.

danny denton.name: Danny Denton
danny denton.origin: Danny Denton repaired his television and discovered he had somehow modified it so that the images and items it broadcast could be interacted with and taken out of the television. He took advantage of this to take for himself all the prizes from a gameshow. He then saw a monster movie with a beautiful woman being terrorised, and decided to bring her into reality as well. However, the monster from the movie followed her out into reality and killed Danny.

danny matthews.name: Danny Matthews
danny matthews.origin: As a private in the California National Guard, Danny Matthews was working on a secret project at Los Angeles Air Force Base. Unknown to him, Andrew Christensen, the scientist he worked with, was an agent of A.I.M.. Captain America had been made aware of A.I.M.'s interest in the project prior to his death and left a video message for Iron Man to look into the situation. . Later, Matthews was transferred to a fire-fighting unit near San Diego and promoted to sergeant. His unit had to battle a wildfire that was inadvertently caused by a rampaging Hulk.

danny poll.name: Danny Poll
danny poll.origin: In the year 1927, Private Danny Poll became jealous of his superior officer Lieutenant Callen due to their rivaling affections for a girl name Marie. Not liking being spoken down to by a low ranking officer, Callen started a fight. Mad with rage, Poll attempted to bash Callen's brains out with a rock, but the two were pulled apart by other military staff. For attempting to kill his superior officer, Poll was court-martialed and was spared the firing squad due to the fact that they were not in a war. Instead, Poll was sentenced to 15 years in solitary confinement. As Danny rotted in prison, he vowed to get revenge unaware that Callen married Marie, and the two actually attempted to get Danny freed from prison but were unsuccessful due to the red tape. Danny was freed in the fall of 1942 and began thinking up how to get revenge against Callen for putting him behind bars. Unable to get the idea of a firing squad out of his head, Danny spotted a bank robbery in progress and noted the mobsters' sloppy execution. Thinking he could train the crooks to be more efficient, Danny jumped on the back of their vehicle and rode to their farmhouse hideout. There, Danny found that one of the mobsters carelessly left his tommy gun in the car. Entering the house, he overheard an altercation brewing between the mobsters and their boss who insisted on taking 50% of their haul even though he did nothing on the job. Danny burst in and shot the mob leader dead, then made the gang an offer they could not refuse: Let him give them military training to make them more efficient, and he will split all of their ill gotten gains evenly. The mobsters accepted the offer and the Firing Squad was born. After extensive training and creating their own uniforms, the Firing Squad robbed a bank. They were opposed by the Angel, but they managed to escape. However, Danny managed to accidentally drop his wallet at the scene of the crime. The Angel used this to track Danny down to his room at the Hotel Regent. There, the hero clashed with the Firing Squad but was tossed out of the 10th floor window of the hotel room. Danny then began plotting his next scheme: This one targeting Callen (now a Major) who recently inherited his family's fortune. Knowing that Callen now had a son, he intended to kidnap the boy for ransom and then murder Callen when the ransom was paid. Unaware that the Angel had survived and overheard this, the Firing Squad had to face the hero and the police at the Callen home. During the fight, Danny was confronted by Marie, and this reunion -- plus the realization that she had married Callen and birthed the child he had come to kidnap -- distracted Danny enough to be captured by the authorities but the rest of his mob managed to escape. When Danny was brought to court, the rest of the Firing Squad stormed the court house and freed their leader. They also managed to capture Cullen's son and make a clean getaway. They later sent a ransom note demanding that they get paid $50,000 for the safe release of the Callen child, the money to be delivered to their farmhouse by Callen himself. There, Callen was put through a mock trial and "sentenced" to death by firing squad. However, before they could execute Callen, the Angel once more intervened. During the fight, the police arrived with Marie, and while the Angel sent Callen and his son to safety, Marie confronted Danny. When Danny attempted to shoot Callen, Marie stood in the way of his bullets and was fatally wounded instead. Realizing the horrible mistake he had made, Danny then walked into the cross fire between his gang and the police and was mowed down. The Angel then helped the authorities round up the rest of the gang, who crumbled easily with their leader now dead.

danny summers.name: Danny Summers
danny summers.origin: Danny Summers was a wealthy friend of Frank Drake. When Drake squandered his personal fortune, he went to Danny to attempt to get a loan, which Danny flatly refused. This last refusal of a loan led Frank Drake to attempt to cash in his ownership of Castle Dracula, which brought a return of Dracula, and plunged Drake into a quest to destroy his age old ancestor. A few years later after fighting alongside Quincy Harker's vampire hunters and forming a romance with Rachel van Helsing, Frank needed time away to rediscover who he was during a time that the hunters thought Dracula to be dead. Frank contacted his old friend Danny who offered him a job working for his new company Summers Inc. which was involved in a government dig in Brazil. Danny took Frank to the site of his most recent dig, and Frank eventually learned that all its workers were really zombies. As it turned out, Danny had been hired by Dracula to eliminate Frank Drake. Frank escaped his deathtrap with the aid of Brother Voodoo. After defeating the zombies, Brother Voodoo revealed to Frank that Danny Summers was responsible for summoning the zombies. Tracking Danny down, Frank punched him out and demanded to know who it was that hired Danny to try and murder him. Danny revealed that Dracula was his employer and that he had no choice because the vampire lord put him under a hypnotic spell. Although Frank was reluctant to believe Danny, he let him go anyway.

danny winchell.name: Danny Winchell
danny winchell.origin: Danny Winchell is the young son of Alice Winchell a resident of Belle Porte, Connecticut. He was regularly babysat by Kate Dwyer, who later went on to baby sit Franklin Richards, son of Reed and Sue Richards, who were living incognito in Belle Porte at the time as the "Benjamin" family. Danny was present when his mother caught Alma Chalmers spying on the "Benjamin" family.

danny wyatt.name: Danny Wyatt
danny wyatt.origin: Danny tells Hazel that he's embarrassed of his poverty otherwise he'd marry her. What he doesn't know is that Hazel is from Pluto and her father Zig sets out to prove Danny is not serious about his offer of marriage. Zig tells Danny that he'll reward him if Danny hides him from the police who are looking for the pilot of the flying saucer. Danny agrees and Zig uses advanced technology to transform Danny's house and vehicles. Danny begins dating pretty girls and when Hazel shows up reminding him of his promise he jilts her. Hazel tells Zig he was right about Danny and the two leave, taking their wealth with them.

dansen macabre.name: Dansen Macabre
dansen macabre.origin: ===Cult of Kali=== A member of the Cult of Kali, a Nepalese cult that studied martial arts and mystical disciplines, Dansen Macabre hypnotized Spider-Man into battling the Shroud for her, hoping to kill him as punishment for running away from the cult temple and his devotion to fighting crime. The Shroud managed to shake Spider-Man from his trance, and they defeated her together. She was later captured by the criminal, Locksmith, who was embarking on a plan to capture superhuman beings and keep them imprisoned so that regular humans could be free to strive and achieve without being overshadowed. The Locksmith had also captured Spider-Woman, who managed to escape, defeat Locksmith, and free the prisoners she trusted. Dansen Macabre (and the other criminal prisoners) were turned over to the police. Shortly after the Secret Wars, the Venom symbiote made its way to the Club Venom nightclub, where an eyeless Deadpool battled X-51 and a group of cyborg cultists under the thrall of Dansen Macabre, the leader of the Mech-Lords of Hell sect of the Cult of Kali. Despite being blind, Deadpool was able to kill some of the cultists, but was disarmed and restrained by X-51. Deadpool's eyes began to regenerate, but just as he began to succumb to Dansen Macabre's mind-control, the symbiote bonded to him. Sprouting a fanged mouth, Deadpool slammed X-51 to the ground and threatened to eat his brains, which X-51 urged him to do so that he would no longer be a threat. Deadpool regained control of himself, knocked X-51 out, and used the symbiote's tentacles to wield multiple guns and swords simultaniously. Killing several cultists, he discovered that the symbiote could shoot webbing like Spider-Man, and used it to restrain Dansen Macabre and the remaining cultists. ===Night Shift=== At some point, Dansen Macabre was contacted by the Shroud to join his team of criminals called the Night Shift, the circumstances of which remain unrevealed. Macabre was elected as deputy leader of the group and often led the team in criminal endeavors when the Shroud was absent, such as leading an attack on the West Coast Avengers in revenge for capturing the Night Shift member, Digger. In this encounter, Dansen Macabre was defeated by the Scarlet Witch. Eventually, the Night Shift mutinied against the Shroud's leadership, and came under the sway of the Hangman and Satannish. Dansen Macabre later became a member of Superia's all-female team of supervillains, the Femizons. Macabre worked with the Night Shift again to join forces with the Hood in a fight against the Midnight Sons. In the fight, she quickly overpowered Jennifer Kale, who called her a skank for dancing and fighting naked. Macabre was briefly out of the fight, however, when Morbius attacked and bit her. When she meant to retaliate, an airborne virus turned her and the rest of Night Shift into zombies. They were then under the control of Dormammu, who ordered them to keep attacking the Midnight Sons. While the Midnight Sons managed to stop Dormammu's plans, the Hood was thankful and teleported away with the Night Shift. Macabre next appeared in Paris, somehow dezombified, attempting to put the entire city under trance, when she was stopped by the Mighty Avengers. thumb Dansen, as part of Night Shift, was hired by Snapdragon to take down Moon Knight, and failing to, was killed along with most of the rest of the Night Shift by the LA Kingpin. ===Superior Spider-Man=== Macabre was seen alive again with a new Night Shift team in San Francisco. They attempted to rob a bus full of people when they were stopped by the Superior Octopus. He quickly overpowered the team, but instead of arresting them made them the offer to become his henchmen, as he was new to the city. The group accepted and Octavius swung away. Together with Digger and Octavius, who now went by Superior Spider-Man, she stopped a new cult from resurrecting their dead master. After using her hypnotic dance to make them go to the police, Macabre asked Octavius out for dinner, which he rejected on grounds of professionalism. Night Shift later attempted to help Octavius battle Terrax, but quickly disappeared when they realized he was out of their weight-class.

dante alighieri.name: Dante Alighieri
dante alighieri.origin: Since Dante's tale of his journey to the underworld has been given conflicting accounts, the true nature of his adventure cannot be confirmed. ===Inferno=== In his narrative poem "Inferno" Dante recounts his journey to actual "Hell" to save his beloved Beatrice from damnation because of him. He fought his way through the Nine Circles of Hell, defeating all manner demons. In the Second Circle of Hell, he encountered King Minos who allowed him to travel beyond his realm further into the depths of Hell. He managed to save Beatrice but was confronted by Lucifer himself, whom Dante in his quest has unwittingly freed. However, Dante opposes him and, using all the souls he managed to save and redeem against him, he re-imprisons Lucifer, and thus earns his redemption. ===Savage Land=== Belasco kidnapped Beatrice to give birth to the first of this new race. He took her to Pangea in the Savage Land, where the Elder Gods directed him to Mount Flavius, a location from which they could be summoned. While on their way, Belasco raped Beatrice, resulting in her being nine months pregnant by the time they arrived. Being closely pursued by Dante and his men, Belasco took Beatrice into a network of underground passages that were meant to resemble Hell. Dante arrived just in time to witness Beatrice dying in childbirth and he attacked Belasco. During this fight, a pipe was accidentally struck and an unknown liquid escaped, placing Belasco in suspended animation. ===Legacy=== When Doctor Strange and four X-Men were seemingly cast into Hell, it was Strange's knowledge of Dante's poem that helped guide them on their journey through that supposed Hell.

fields.notes: This is a fictionalized version of , a real historical figure. Although the Italian poet Dante Aligheri existed in the Marvel Universe and his famous narrative poem Inferno has been referenced there a number of times, there have as yet been no stories published in which someone visits Hell and finds that its configuration matches the Nine Circles of Hell described in the poem. While this may not be true for all of the many Hell Dimensions that exist in the Marvel Multiverse, so far an actual Hell that's exactly like Dante's version has not yet been encountered. In , four X-Men and Doctor Strange were abducted from Earth by magic and woke up in a place which Strange recognized as being like the Hell described in Dante's poem. However, throughout their entire time there, Strange never got the psychic sense of fundamental evil of which a true Hell should have reeked. It was ultimately revealed that this was actually a "facsimile of Dante's Hell" that had been created by a powerful sorceress, Margali of the Winding Road, in order to suitably punish her foster son, Kurt Wagner, for having (she thought) foully murdered her biological son, Stefan. Once it had been revealed that Kurt had accidentally killed Stefan in a struggle while trying to prevent him from continuing to kill innocent children, Margali returned all five captives to Earth. In - , after a volcanic eruption in Pangea had uncovered a long-hidden doorway, Shanna recognized the words inscribed over the portal as being from Dante's poem. As Ka-Zar, Shanna and Buth began exploring the network of connecting underground tunnels on the other side of the entryway, they encountered beings and locations that Shanna felt resembled Dante's "Hell" too closely for comfort and, while the others believed that it was just a thrill-ride that had been part of the long-abandoned amusement park created by the ancient Atlanteans, Shanna became increasingly convinced that it was Dante's Inferno. The trio (and Zabu) eventually discovered, in a subterranean city that Shanna identified as Dis, a ship's log written by Captain Dante Aligheri that detailed how he and his crew had pursued the condemned sorcerer Belasco after he had escaped from prison, kidnapped Dante's beloved Beatrice Portinari and fled southwards to a place of terrible cold and whiteness (Antarctica) where they found s hidden paradise (Pangea). With help from a winged man, Ver-Jeel, Dante and his surviving men followed Belasco into dark caverns dark caverns where Belasco ended up being frozen in ice during a swordfight with Dante. Cut off from the rest of his party by an earthquake, Dante left the log in the city, hoping his men would find it. After finding and reading that ancient book, Ka-Zar and Shanna theorized that Dante, after returning home to Florence, had included some details from this adventure when he wrote Inferno years later.

dante chapman.origin: Along with Shameek Smith and Chico Diaz, Dante Chapman participated in the robbery of a gun sale between Cottonmouth and Domingo Colon. During the robbery Dante realized he would be suspected in the inside hit because he had called sick on that day. To prevent him from snitching, Shameek shot Dante and left him for dead, though Dante still managed to inform Tone before dying.

danton vayla.name: Danton Vayla
danton vayla.origin: Danton Vayla was the leader of a high-profile satanic cult called the Brotherhood of Baal in Los Angeles. He and his followers believed that soul transmigration was possible, meaning that a person's soul could be transferred from one body to another. Lissa Russell joined the cult hoping to find a cure for her brother, Jack's, lycanthropy. News of the cult's idea of soul transmigration even reached as far East as New York City, where it reached the ears of the wandering Frankenstein's Monster. Tired of being regarded as a monster and having to roam the world alone, the creature hid himself aboard a cargo train in a New York trainyard that was bound for Los Angeles, hoping the cult could help him. Before he arrived in L.A., however, he was discovered on the train and was forced to crash through the side of the train car, not realizing that the train was overlooking a giant cliff aside the Pacific Ocean. The train security believed that no one could survive such a fall, but members of the Brotherhood of Baal discovered the behemoth roaming the beaches and followed them to their leader. Vayla understood what it was the monster wanted, a normal form and a normal existence, and promised to provide it to him. Meanwhile, Lissa had come to the conclusion that the cult were nothing more than a bunch of crackpots and quit, going home to her step-father's house. Vayla, however, decided to make an example of her and any others whose belief wavered. It was she that was decided upon as the sacrifice needed for the cult's soul transmigration to take place. When Jack arrived at his step-father's home, he saw that it had been ransacked and soon realized that the cult had kidnapped his sister. After discovering the cult's location, Jack drove to save her, not caring that night was coming on and it was the time of the full moon. As Jack transformed, his car went off the road and the Werewolf fled into the forest, coincidently heading in the same direction as the cult's headquarters. The Werewolf crashed into the headquarters and attacked the cult's members. The Frankenstein's monster came to their aid, believing this to be his one chance to live a normal life. After a bloody battle, Frankenstein's Monster knocked the Werewolf unconscious, and when he awoke he found himself the new sacrificial victim for the cult's spell. Just before Vayla could sacrifice the Werewolf, however, he told of the ritual's real purpose, to allow Satan to inhabit the body of the Frankenstein's Monster, not thinking that the monster would understand him. Vayla proved to be mistaken as the Monster grabbed the knife from his hands and threw him against a large inverted cross on the wall, which crashed on top of him, killing him. The rest of the cult met a similar end as the Monster and the Werewolf fought together, eventually causing the place to catch aflame. The seaside property soon toppled into the sea, effectively ending the threat of the cult.

daphne.name: Daphne
daphne.origin: Daphne was a minor nature deity among the Olympian pantheon. In ancient history, she was pursued by Apollo. She fled him and in order to escape begged the gods for help, who in turn transformed her into a laurel tree. Eventually restored to humanoid form once more, Daphne came to reside on Olympus. When Olympus was moved to the planet Venus, she lived there as well. In 1949, Zeus (then calling himself under his Roman named of Jupiter) returned from a leave of absence. Noticing that Aphrodite (then calling herself Venus) had abandoned the Olympians to live among the mortals of Earth became furious. He attempted to force her to return to Olympus, but agreed to a challenge: Venus had to find a mortal couple with everlasting love within a week or be forced to return to Olympus. Venus found this in the couple Meg Saunder and Danny Lane who were scheduled to be married in a week. Seeking to prevent the couple from being broken apart by the machinations of Jupiter, she took them on a vacation to Hollywood as Jupiter despised actors. Jupiter instead sent Apollo and Daphne to Earth, having them disguise themselves as wealthy mortals Renee Andre and Rona Belladonna. As "Rona Belladonna", Daphne attempted to seduce Danny, but her attempts to do so did not begin to work until both she and Apollo framed Meg for "Renee's" murder. However, before Daphne could use her charm on Danny and make him kiss her, Venus appeared and used her godly powers to force Daphne to reveal Jupiter's plan and also forced Apollo to reveal that he was never really dead. With Meg and Danny married, Daphne and Apollo were returned to Olympus and Jupiter allowed Venus to stay on Earth.

daphne plepler.name: Daphne Plepler
daphne plepler.origin: Daphne Plepler started dating the necromancer Michael Hawthorne after meeting through a social network for people interested in magic called "Magic Mingle." After an on-and-off relationship, the two became a formal couple. She eventually became pregnant by Michael and the two were expecting a child. On the day Daphne and Michael were going to reveal the former's pregnancy to her parents, Michael's friend and ally Deadpool abruptly interrupted their lunch with her parents and took Michael to have him help in a supernatural emergency in Monster Metropolis, which was being attacked by the magic-siphoning army known as the Empirikul. Michael died during the conflict, sacrificing his life when casting a spell that saved the entire city. Later that night, Deadpool visited Daphne in her apartment to inform her of the tragedy. She broke down in tears, and in a fit of rage blamed Deadpool for killing Michael and orphaning their unborn child.

daquis.name: Daquis
daquis.origin: Lord Daquis was a well-respected merchant and the father of the woman who came to be known as Valeria, as well as the husband of Lady Merina. Conflicting accounts of Lord Daquis' death have been given. Initially, on the night she fled from Clesus and an arranged marriage to Dom Delaris, Val told a merchant in Kordava, Zingara that her father was slain on the Vilayet Sea by a Turanian captain for consorting with a Red Brotherhood captain known as Kirkos, who was in fact his brother, Brandus; however, Val later recalled her father losing his life defending she and her mother from an inland raid by Zingaran pirates on their village in southern Aquilonia.

dar benn.name: Dar-Benn
dar benn.origin: ===Early Life=== Dar-Benn was born on Kree-Lar a planet in the heart of the Kree Empire. From a young age, both showed exceptional dedication to the military traditions of the Kree Empire. They joined the Kree military at an early stage in their lives, steadily rising through the ranks due to their strategic acumen and combat prowess. Their careers set the foundation for their eventual leadership roles within the Kree military hierarchy. ===Conspiracy Against Emperor Clumsy Foulup=== In the aftermath of extensive military funding cuts imposed by the Kree Emperor known as Clumsy Foulup, two prominent Kree generals, Ael-Dan and Dar-Benn, grew increasingly dissatisfied with his leadership. Viewing the Emperor's greed and fiscal negligence as a threat to the stability of the Empire, they secretly conspired to remove him from power and install themselves as joint rulers. To execute their plan, Ael-Dan and Dar-Benn commissioned Dr. Kaer-Linn, an advanced robotics specialist, to construct a highly realistic robotic duplicate of the Silver Surfer, intended to act as their weapon during the assassination. This surrogate would serve to divert blame and obscure the true source of the attack. During this time, Thanos acquired the Infinity Gauntlet, leading to the catastrophic event in which half of all sentient life in the universe including a significant portion of the Kree population and their Cotati allies vanished. With the Empire destabilised and public trust faltering, Ael-Dan and Dar-Benn moved to advance their plot. The two generals convened a covert meeting with six trusted high-ranking military officers. Outraged by a new imperial tax decree issued by Clumsy Foulup amid galactic crisis, Ael-Dan denounced the Emperor's actions and destroyed a communications monitor in protest. Though Foulup claimed the new taxes would fund military recovery, the conspirators were convinced he was merely enriching himself. Dar-Benn then unveiled their strategy: a public assassination of both Clumsy Foulup and his closest advisor, Dwi-Zann, during a scheduled live broadcast. The assassination would be carried out by the artificial Silver Surfer duplicate, creating a pretext for war and providing cover for their coup. The joint leadership structure was designed to prevent renewed hostilities between the blue and pink Kree. One officer, Aa-Gorn, objected to the method and suggested alternative means such as poison. However, Ael-Dan and Dar-Benn insisted that only a public killing would guarantee legitimacy. When Aa-Garn attempted to act against the plan, Ael-Dan shot and killed him on the spot. The generals then claimed the Surfer had voluntarily allied with them as penance for his past involvement with the Skrulls during the Kree-Skrull War. Later that evening, during Clumsy Foulup's broadcast, the Surfer duplicate executed both Dwi-Zann and the Emperor. As the imperial studio crew were held at gunpoint by the conspirators, the murders were broadcast live across the empire. Moments later, Ael-Dan and Dar-Benn, clad in ceremonial battle armor, entered the studio and publicly destroyed the faux Surfer. Addressing the Kree people, the generals falsely claimed the assassination had been orchestrated by the Skrulls and that the robotic Surfer was their assassin. They vowed revenge, declared martial law, and pledged to lead the Empire into a new war of retribution. They also promised that elections would be held after the crisis had been resolved. Once the broadcast ended, Ael-Dan and Dar-Benn gathered the remains of the robotic Surfer and transported them to Advanced Robotics Lab 28, a long-abandoned facility occupied by Dr. Kaer-Linn. Upon their arrival, the scientist inquired about the unit's performance. Dar-Benn praised Kaer-Linn's construction and programming at which point Ael-Dan fatally stabbed the doctor to eliminate any witnesses. Dar-Benn then placed an explosive charge in the lab to erase all evidence of the robotic imposter and its creator. With the assassination complete, the public deceived, and all loose ends severed, the new co-commanders turned their attention to consolidating power and investigating the disappearance of half the Kree Empire. ===Defunding of Korath-Thak's Research=== At some point during their joint rule, Ael-Dan and Dar-Benn terminated funding for the research projects overseen by Korath-Thak, a prominent Kree cyber-geneticist. dar benn.bio: ===Early Life=== Dar-Benn was born on Kree-Lar a planet in the heart of the Kree Empire. From a young age, both showed exceptional dedication to the military traditions of the Kree Empire. They joined the Kree military at an early stage in their lives, steadily rising through the ranks due to their strategic acumen and combat prowess. Their careers set the foundation for their eventual leadership roles within the Kree military hierarchy. ===Conspiracy Against Emperor Clumsy Foulup=== In the aftermath of extensive military funding cuts imposed by the Kree Emperor known as Clumsy Foulup, two prominent Kree generals, Ael-Dan and Dar-Benn, grew increasingly dissatisfied with his leadership. Viewing the Emperor's greed and fiscal negligence as a threat to the stability of the Empire, they secretly conspired to remove him from power and install themselves as joint rulers. To execute their plan, Ael-Dan and Dar-Benn commissioned Dr. Kaer-Linn, an advanced robotics specialist, to construct a highly realistic robotic duplicate of the Silver Surfer, intended to act as their weapon during the assassination. This surrogate would serve to divert blame and obscure the true source of the attack. During this time, Thanos acquired the Infinity Gauntlet, leading to the catastrophic event in which half of all sentient life in the universe including a significant portion of the Kree population and their Cotati allies vanished. With the Empire destabilised and public trust faltering, Ael-Dan and Dar-Benn moved to advance their plot. The two generals convened a covert meeting with six trusted high-ranking military officers. Outraged by a new imperial tax decree issued by Clumsy Foulup amid galactic crisis, Ael-Dan denounced the Emperor's actions and destroyed a communications monitor in protest. Though Foulup claimed the new taxes would fund military recovery, the conspirators were convinced he was merely enriching himself. Dar-Benn then unveiled their strategy: a public assassination of both Clumsy Foulup and his closest advisor, Dwi-Zann, during a scheduled live broadcast. The assassination would be carried out by the artificial Silver Surfer duplicate, creating a pretext for war and providing cover for their coup. The joint leadership structure was designed to prevent renewed hostilities between the blue and pink Kree. One officer, Aa-Gorn, objected to the method and suggested alternative means such as poison. However, Ael-Dan and Dar-Benn insisted that only a public killing would guarantee legitimacy. When Aa-Garn attempted to act against the plan, Ael-Dan shot and killed him on the spot. The generals then claimed the Surfer had voluntarily allied with them as penance for his past involvement with the Skrulls during the Kree-Skrull War. Later that evening, during Clumsy Foulup's broadcast, the Surfer duplicate executed both Dwi-Zann and the Emperor. As the imperial studio crew were held at gunpoint by the conspirators, the murders were broadcast live across the empire. Moments later, Ael-Dan and Dar-Benn, clad in ceremonial battle armor, entered the studio and publicly destroyed the faux Surfer. Addressing the Kree people, the generals falsely claimed the assassination had been orchestrated by the Skrulls and that the robotic Surfer was their assassin. They vowed revenge, declared martial law, and pledged to lead the Empire into a new war of retribution. They also promised that elections would be held after the crisis had been resolved. Once the broadcast ended, Ael-Dan and Dar-Benn gathered the remains of the robotic Surfer and transported them to Advanced Robotics Lab 28, a long-abandoned facility occupied by Dr. Kaer-Linn. Upon their arrival, the scientist inquired about the unit's performance. Dar-Benn praised Kaer-Linn's construction and programming at which point Ael-Dan fatally stabbed the doctor to eliminate any witnesses. dara.name: Dara
dara.origin: Dara was an Atlantean member of the royal family. He along with his twin brother Seth were born into the House of Thakorr. As Namor's cousins, they became his close friends and were loved by the people of Atlantis. He was later following Attuma as leader of Atlantis, as he feared for his land. Artys-Gran, queen of the Unforgiven Dead, took possession of the body of Princess Fen to sneak into Atlantis in a plot to summon the Old Ones. When her deception was revealed, Dara angrily put a blade to Artys-Gran's throat. However, the Atlanteans were under a magic spell. The spell caused an Atlantean woman to throw a spear at Dara, striking him and killing him.

dara ko eke.name: Dara Ko Eke
dara ko eke.origin: ===Origins=== Dara Ko Eke was a Badoon Moord, an offshoot created by the Kree. She went through Amphogenesis, the process that grants her people powers. Obtaining psionic abilities, she was called "All-Knowing". ===Universal Inhumans and Light Brigade=== She became a member of the Light Brigade among the Universal Inhumans. The Brigade were sent through Eldrac to the Negative Zone to participate in a great challenge of their abilities. The team was captured by Arthrosians in Negative Zone, and Annihilus made them fight on the arena to the death against the Arthrosian champions. When Human Torch was captured, he teamed up with the Light Brigade and they escaped. They attacked Annihilus and Johnny took away his Cosmic Control Rod. After that, Johnny opened a portal to the Baxter Building and they all returned to Earth. Along with the Universal Inhumans, Dara relocated to the great city of Novahala, on the continent of Akuunos of the planet Centauri-IV. As the Inhuman Queens had to discuss with Medusa as she brought dire news about Black Bolt during her quest for the origin of the Inhumans, the Light Brigade were tasked to give a tour to Medusa's crew, and the group ended up entertaining themselves in the Circle of Testing Fire, the training arena. ===Badoon leader=== Dara Ko Eke found herself leading a female Badoon settlement on the planet Geunee, all of them also taking a vow of nonviolence. Dara also seemingly stopped using her Inhuman name, "the All-Knowing", going by her birth name. Their village became terrorized by Saarl the Slaughterer (who forced them to fight in gladiator-style combats for his entertainment, thus forcing them to compromise on their vow), one of the Badoon's Swamp Gods. To help her, Loki took the form of Captain Marvel and enlisted the help of Echo (Maya Lopez) (pretending Dara was asking for help). Despite being unannounced and assaulted by Badoon at first, Echo was welcomed by Dara. Exchanging on their respective paths, Dara offered the troubled Echo the use of her psychic powers to see her future, but saw only fire. The next morning, Echo and the Badoon went to Saarl, and Echo easily defeated him. Rather than slaying him, she put his fate in the Badoon's hands. Despite Dara's proposition to stay among them for a while, Echo was now ready to deal with her own unfinished business, as planned by Loki.

daraxus dax.name: Daraxus Dax
daraxus dax.origin: An alien on a world targeted by the giant bullet that Kitty Pryde was briefly stuck inside. Not knowing the bullet was in a phased state, the planet's populace was told they had five years before impact. Descending into chaos, the world erupted in anarchy. While many of the rich managed to leave the planet in spaceships, those who couldn't afford it were left with their seeming end drawing near. During this chaos, Daraxus killed a random individual, an act he came to regret, leaving his fruit ration outside the door of a neighbor's apartment as a way of paying penance. As the bullet drew near, Daraxus was one many who stood on the planet's surface, wanting to face destruction head-on. As the bullet drew near, his neighbor approached him, informing him that she knew what he had been doing, and as the world's end came about...and both were equally shocked when the bullet passed through their world, giving them a second chance at life.

darby.origin: Darby was a member of the Skull-Crushers motorcycle gang. Together with French and their leader Snake, he tracked Ruth Hart into the Everglades after Snake blamed her for taking the gang’s treasure. darby dean.name: Darby Dean
darby dean.origin: Susan and Darby Dean were a happily married couple who were also anti-mutant activists. When they learned that one of their two unborn twin daughters would be a mutant, they agreed to terminate the mutant fetus. The procedure was halted, but not before the mutant fetus was seemingly destroyed. However, the fetus was revealed to have been transferred to another dimension by its sister, Laura, who was also a mutant. Laura grew up being considered autistic, communicating rarely with the world. Her parents, in an effort to help her, sent her to the New Life Clinic in Vancouver, British Columbia. However, while there, Laura was drafted into the Derangers, after which she joined Beta Flight. The deans were apparently unaware of their daughter's location and activities. When Alpha Flight was put on trial, news footage aired internationally by the media showed the Deans their daughter fighting alongside the team. They later pursued this lead to Ottawa, shortly after Laura was injured by Wild Child. They offered her a blood transfusion and to take her home when they learned that Heather Hudson, leader of Alpha Flight, intended to file for custody of Laura and her sister Goblyn. While visiting Laura, she suddenly woke up and transported the Deans and Beta Flight to Liveworld to save Goblyn from the Dreamqueen. Upon their eventual return to Earth, the Deans left their daughters in the care of Alpha Flight and have not been heard from since.

darell paine.name: Darell Paine
darell paine.origin: 2-D is a member of the Liberteens, the Pennsylvanian team of the 50-state Initiative. He was inspired by the Thin Man. He was with the Liberteens when they saved the Liberty Bell from Flag-Smasher and U.L.T.I.M.A.T.U.M. terrorists. When meteors that had fallen from the heavens threatened to cause a mass panic, Commander Steven Rogers asked Prodigy to gather heroes on a volunteer basis to help keep the peace and lead a new Initiative where there was no forced conscription or registration. Most of the former Initiative members, including 2-D, gathered in Washington, D.C.. 2-D and his fellow Liberteens Hope, Iceberg, and Ms. America later left the Liberteens and formed their own team called the Fantastix to replace the disbanded Fantastic Four. They were also able to gain ownership of the Baxter Building. The Fantastix's first mission was stopping the Wrecking Crew from robbing a jewelry store that just across the street from the Baxter Building. The real Fantastic Four later showed up and revealed that the robbery was actually staged by the Fantastix's manager and publicist Brenda Bannicheck in order to boost the team's popularity. 2-D and his team then got the blessing of the Fantastic Four to continue using the Baxter Building. The Fantastix saw little action during their subsequent career, mostly due to being stand-ins for the Fantastic Four with the Fantastic Four being around. When the powerful alien Cormorant scoured the Earth in search for a mysterious artifact, he unceremoniously destroyed the entirety of the Baxter Building to unearth Container Zero. When the Fantastic Four, Doctor Doom and Victorious arrived to confront the Cormorant, the Fantastix joined the fight. After the destruction of Container Zero ended with the creation of the Forever Gate and the Cormorant left, Mister Fantastic decided to reclaim what was left of the Baxter Building so his team could guard the portal. Despite being offered to help carry this duty, the Fantastix decided to leave it all to the Fantastic Four.

dargil.name: Dargil
dargil.origin: Dargil was a servant of the much more powerful demon Mephisto who was sent to investigate the disappearance of a soul forsworn to Mephisto by its owner. When Dargil arrived, the owner was prepared, and cut off his head, affixing it to a chain, making him his servant. That owner had sealed his soul in brass armor and taken the moniker, the Brass Bishop. Dargil served the Bishop for many years, taking and sucking the souls out of whomever the Bishop wanted and feeding it to him. When the Bishop needed Puck to find the Solomon Seal, a mystical key which could open the gates to heaven, Dargil sucked out his soul, into the Brass Bishop, turning Puck into a mindless drone, obedient to the Bishop. However, Puck was able to free himself enough to use the Seal on the Bishop, freeing his soul for Mephisto to take back to his dimension. Presumably, Dargil also returned to Mephisto's dimension.

dargin bokk.name: Dargin Bokk
dargin bokk.species: Mental representation of Chris Powell's psyche fracturing. Falsely an extraterrestrial using a Darkhawk suit.
dargin bokk.origin: Dargin Bokk was a manifestation of Chris Powell's psyche fracturing because he was incapable of bonding with his Darkhawk body. ===Fictional biography=== In his fictional existence, Dargin Bokk was an extraterrestrial from the planet Luq. He was an intergalactic crime lord, using his resources to commission five scientists to create the Darkhawk Android. But when the scientists eventually used it to assault Bokk, he managed to take one of the crystals and uses it to assume the Darkhawk body called Evilhawk. However, in the ensuing fight, as the starship is sucked into Null Space, Bokk's original body was destroyed in the explosion, trapping him in his android body. Eventually, Evilhawk learned that a human, Chris Powell, had gained access to the Darkhawk Amulet. He travelled to the planet Earth to face him. When he arrived on Earth, Evilhawk confronted Darkhawk and the to battled. Evilhawk attacks Darkhawk, destroying his android body as his conscious ended up in his human body within the starship. Evilhawk battled St. Johnny and the Powell family before returning to the starship to execute his place, transferring his mind into Chris' body. But the plan failed and Evilhawk's was destroyed by Darkhawk. Bokk returned to fight Osch, one of the alien scientist who helped build the Evilhawk armor, on the psychic plane, but failed to create a new android body for himself. ===Revelation=== His origin and falseness were later revealed by the Raptor Talon to Powell. This revelation by implication also undoes the origins of Overhawk, Ocsh, Portal, St. Johnny, Ned Dobbs, and the Mahari Brothers.

darius destroyer.name: Darius (Destroyer)
darius destroyer.origin: left|thumb|Darius as Turret Darius served for years as the partner of the Destroyer in the guise of Turret. He had presumably been empowered through the same process that gave the Destroyer his powers, with Marlow calling Turret his greatest achievement. At some point, Darius met Marlow's daughter, Felecia, and the two began dating, though she didn't know that Darius was in reality her father's superhero partner. When the two got married, Keene convinced Darius to give up the superhero life for the sake of his daughter. He didn't want her to have to make the same sacrifices that his own wife, Harriet, had had to endure. Darius remained retired for over eight years, admiring the Destroyer's work from afar and starting a family of his own. When the Destroyer learned that he was soon going to die, however, he decided to kill off anyone who could present a threat to his family after he was gone. Learning that the Destroyer was looking for him, his old nemesis Scar decided to come out of retirement himself. He kidnapped Darius' wife and blew up his house in an effort to lure the Destroyer into a trap. Darius decided to once again don his Turret costume and help the Destroyer in order to rescue his wife. The duo tracked Scar to an old tire factory where they were ambushed by Scar and a group of other super-villains including Bruiser, Crocodile and the Organite. Scar also slit Felecia's wrists, leaving her to die. Turret managed to knock out the Organite before rescuing Felecia in time to save her life. The other villains, including Scar, were all killed by an irate Destroyer. While recovering in hospital, Marlow learned the location of the central headquarters for Horde and left to lead an assault, despite not being one hundred percent. Learning that his wife would be alright, Darius followed the assault team and saved the Destroyer's life, in addition, he killed the monstrous leader of Horde, Krakoom, nearly all by himself. When he returned to the hospital, his wife was furious with him after discovering that her husband had kept his secret identity from her for all these years. When Techtronica had downloaded her consciousness into several computer programmers at the Pentagon, it was Darius that they approached to stop her. He donned the Destroyer costume and became the successor of the Destroyer name. His wife, Felecia, decided that while it's a hard life, she would be proud for Darius to be a hero like her father.

Davis eventually served his term and was released, but felt that Geoffrey had betrayed him, leading to animosity between the two for the next two decades.

darius zorn.name: Darius Zorn
darius zorn.origin: A highly wealthy, and highly despised, man, Darius Zorn was synonymous with snobbery. Highly bigoted, Zorn was intolerant of anyone of a different race, refusing to hire any non-white worker in his factories. He also refused to be apart of any organization with even one member that practiced any religion other than his own, feeling that any other religion was inferior to his, and thus not acceptable. After taking a vacation to Eastern Europe, Zorn noticed a forest that glowed a bright orange color. Fascinated with it, he landed and demanded that the mayor of the small country sell him the entire forest. Although hesitant at first, the mayor finally gave Zorn a deed to the forest after Zorn offered a large amount of money. left While entering his new forest, the local farmers of the country warned Zorn of a mysterious "man in black" who lived in the forest, and told him that the man in black promised hardship and famine on the town if anyone entered the forest. Uninterested in the concerns of those poorer than himself, Zorn brushed off the stories and moved into an abandoned estate he found in the middle of the forest. After a visit from the man in black, who warned Zorn of the consequences of staying in the forest, the surrounding farms all suffered famine and drought, rendering the town's crops useless. Zorn still refused to leave the forest, still unconcerned about the farmers' hardships. During a second visit from the man in black, Zorn threatened to have the man arrested. However, the mysterious man knocked Zorn out for several hours. Upon waking up, Zorn found himself in a cage. He was shocked to see the "man in black", who turned out to be a small red and yellow creature. The creature explained that the forest was actually a large trap, intended to find the one human in the world that no one else on the planet would miss. Confident that Zorn was that person, the creature took Zorn back to his home, which was in a different dimension, and entered Zorn into the dimension's zoo, presumably for life.

dark aegis.name: Dark Aegis
dark aegis.first_appearance: Iron Man: The Animated Series Season 2 7
dark aegis.origin: Dark Aegis is a particularly sadistic and ruthless supervillain whom Iron Man faced earlier. He was thought dead during his early battls, but was revealed to be still alive, and the tyrant and destroyer of an innocent planet, whom he massacred because they looked less than human, according to him. He also found powerful weapons known as the Oracles, and began his megalomaniacal quest to become a god amongst the universe. He allied with Titanium Man, and gave him the weapons, so that he could rule over Russia, though soon even he had doubts about Aegis. When Iron Man and War Machine armored up and went to confront the armored maniac, they were horrified to see that he had practically destroyed the planet and killed the entire civilization there. Iron Man went to deal with Aegis, while War Machine went to deal with Titanium Man. Iron Man confronted the now insane Dark Aegis, who now believed himself to be a god, and was offered a chance to become like him with another Oracle weapon, so they can both destroy the suns. When Iron Man refused, an enraged Aegis began to fight him. Soon Titanium Man betrayed him, due to him wanting to lead compared to his genocidal goals. Soon, Aegis was defeated, but he escaped while leaving the armored men to die in the planet's destruction. It took Titanium Man's noble sacrifice to deal with Aegis and bring him to justice. As they fought inside of Aegis' ship, it exploded and killed them both.

dark hunter.name: Dark Hunter
dark hunter.origin: The Dark Hunter is a psionic entity composed of Franklin Richards’ fears and pain, born from his subconscious after the apparent demise of his parents, Reed and Sue Richards. When Franklin, alongside his friends, the Daydreamers, ventured into his mind, believing it to be the Nexus of All Realities, the Dark Hunter manifested to capture him, make him realize his delusions and face his grief. He reached them for the first time when they visited Nevernever-Narnozbia, but he was banished from the realm by Strange, who allowed the Daydreamers to get away safely. When the team was incarcerated in Seuss-land’s police station, he sent unconscious every policeman in the city the building to reach them, but he was stopped by Tana Nile; ultimately, he managed to kidnap Franklin’s friend, the telepath Artie Maddicks. Artie, while in the Dark Hunter’s care, understood the entity’s real nature and scope, to the point of allying himself with him. When Franklin became more and more frustrated with his friends and started sending them away from the realities he had created, the Hunter rescued them with his drakkar. When he and the Daydreamers finally reached out to the child and, after a brief fight, the Hunter convinced Franklin to accept the death of his parents; not having a purpose anymore, the Hunter vanished, after sharing a hug with his creator.

dark ock.name: Dark Ock
dark ock.origin: Dark Ock was a member of the Octopals, a quartet of thieves inspired by Doctor Octopus using functional tentacles who claimed to be the real Doc Ock reincarnated in four different bodies. They used a series of thefts committed by various robbers disguised as super heroes and their antagonists as a cover for their operations. When they were trying to steal a shipment full of smuggler's gold in a shipyard, the Octopals were interrupted by Chipmunk Hunk, Koi Boi and Brain Drain. However, the trio's lack of coordination gave Doctor Cyberock a window of opportunity to escape. While Chipmunk Hunk and Koi Boi were scolding Brain Drain for his failure to work as a team, the other three Octopals fled. The following day, the Octopals returned to the shipyard to resume their plan. They were once again confronted by Chipmunk Hunk, Koi Boi and Brain Drain, with the heroes successfully subduing them this time.

dark crawler.name: Dark-Crawler
dark crawler.origin: The Dark-Crawler was once known as the Night-Crawler and was an ancient enemy of the Undying Ones. A cult worshiping the Undying Ones sent the Hulk to his dimension, hoping that the Hulk would destroy him. To motivate the Hulk to fight, the Undying Ones sent an unconvinced member, Barbara Norriss, knowing that the Night-Crawler would attack her. The battle that followed destroyed both the Night-Crawler's weapon, the Scepter of Shadow, and his realm and he was sucked into the Undying Ones' dimension. Once there, the Night-Crawler battled the Undying Ones up until the moment where their plan to invade Earth was spoiled - meanwhile, the Hulk escaped with the help of the Undying Ones' prisoner, Doctor Strange, and thanks to Norris' sacrifice by staying behind. Defeating the demons and their leader, the Nameless One, the Night-Crawler became the ruler of the Undying Ones, changing his name to the Dark-Crawler. Eventually the Nameless One was again shown to be in control of the Undying Ones, so his fate is currently unknown. Meanwhile, the evil super-genius the Leader discovered the Hulk's past encounter with the Night-Crawler. The Leader then included the Night-Crawler in an array of simulated super-villains that he sent against the Hulk in an attempt to give him a heart attack.

fields.trivia: Creator Jim Starlin is known to recycle names and concepts from his stories. Between 1976-1979 he wrote and penciled five short stories for Warren Publishing's book "Eerie" about Darklon the Mystic; one of his ancestors was Darklore II. darkstrider.name: Darkstrider
darkstrider.origin: Darkstrider first appeared as the leader of a ninja clan, the Warlords of the Web. His men attempted to assassinate Moon Sun, leader of a circus, who sought Shang-Chi's help against Darkstrider. Every member of Moon Sun's circus told Shang a different story about Darkstrider's background: In all versions, he was a ninja either hired to eliminate Moon Sun's circus or a farmer whose wife died from shock at seeing the circus creatures, which caused him to become a ninja and seek the circus' members death himself. After he was defeated by Shang-Chi, he left behind a piece of Moon Sun's robe, suggesting that they might have been the same person all along (and that the circus members were in fact the Warlords of the Web). A man named Darkstrider appeared in the service of Soustriker and Jade Claw. It is unclear whether this was the same person or a different six-armed man named Darkstrider.

darla mutant.name: Darla (Mutant)
darla mutant.origin: Darla grew up in a broken household in a small mining town in the Appalachian Mountains in West Virginia. Her father abandoned the family, and her mother committed suicide due to the stress of dealing with her daughter's emerging mutant powers. Depressed and angry, Darla turned to drugs, which had uncontrollable effects on her powers. Darla was one of two mutants detected in the town by Cerebra, the other being Krystal. The X-Men sent Rogue, Wolverine, and Kitty Pryde to attempt to recruit them. When the X-men arrived, they were inexplicably attacked by several old foes such as Sabretooth - in actuality manifestations of Darla's powers. As the night went on, Darla became more and more unstable, made worse by a new drug she had consumed which, unbeknownst to her, was manufactured by a group of deranged drug cooks who made drugs from mutant bodily fluids, in hopes of "becoming" mutants themselves. Phantasmagoric supervillains, Sentinels, and other manifestations of Darla's powers began to lay waste to the town, drawn from the memories of the X-Men. The drug cooks also joined the assault, seeing Darla as a Messianic figure. The tide began to turn when the late Professor X was manifested from Kitty's memories; realizing they could use Darla's powers against her, they summoned more allies to battle the illusory villains. In the end, Krystal succeeded in calming Darla with her own hypnotic suggestion powers, after revealing that she had been the one who gave the drugs to Darla. The illusory villains vanished, the drug cooks were arrested, and the damage to the down was explained away as the result of a mine collapse.

darla deering.name: Darla Deering
darla deering.origin: Darla Deering was a pop star who dated Johnny Storm, the Human Torch of the Fantastic Four. When Mr. Fantastic planned a trip through space and time, he tasked each member of the team to find a suitable replacement just in case, as the travel was through time, they would return four minutes after they departed. As Johnny forgot to find one, he rushed to Darla's apartment and asked her to take his spot in the Fantastic Four, alongside Ant-Man (replacing Mr. Fantastic), Medusa (replacing the Invisible Woman) and She-Hulk (replacing The Thing), which she accepted. Four minutes after the Fantastic Four departed, they didn't return, prompting the newly cobbled together team to become the acting Fantastic Four and watch over the Future Foundation. She later dated Scott Lang. However the two broke up after the resurrection of his daughter. They reconnected when he was hired as security for a performance of hers in Miami. Darla was transported to an unknown reality alongside other former members of the Fantastic Four by Richards using the Transmaterializer for the purpose of assisting the team in their fight against the Griever at the End of All Things. They fought the Griever and her Endlings while protecting the Future Foundation, until the Fantastic Four destroyed all but one of her Telepods, which forced the Griever to surrender and flee. With the enemy defeated, all members of the Fantastic Four were returned home, including Darla.

darlene wilson.name: Darlene Wilson
darlene wilson.origin: Darlene Wilson lived in Harlem, New York City, married Paul Wilson, a prominent minister. Together they had three children: Sam Wilson, Sarah Wilson, and Gideon Wilson. When Sam was sixteen, he refused to join the church, believing his deeply religious parents to be ignorant for their faith. To his surprise, rather than put up a fight, his parents provide him with books on different religions and comparative theology. The next night; however, Paul was killed trying to break up a neighborhood fight. Two years later, Darlene was shot and killed by a mugger one block from their apartment.

darlene wright.name: Darlene Wright
darlene wright.origin: "Cherry" was the wife of a member of a Tracksuit Mafia. She tried to escape from her husband and flee New York City when she came across Clint Barton, who offered to buy her car. After having a romantic encounter with Barton, she was kidnapped by some members of the Tracksuit Mafia who broke into her apartment and also knocked out Clint. With the help of Kate Bishop, Barton started to chase the gangsters and managed to knock them down one by one. In the end, he accompanied "Cherry" to an airport, where she left the city. She was found by the mafia, as she was needed to open a special safe only she knew the code to, but managed to escape from them, shooting her ex-husband in self defense, and went to the Avengers Mansion asking for Clint's help. Both went to a Russian pub, where Clint caused a distraction while she, whose real name was revealed to be Penny, sneaked in order to get the safe. The following day, Penny revealed to Clint it was she who sent him via mail some comics in a special order, which featured a character similar to her. Clint didn't know about the special order and accidentally mixed them, the number of the issues in that special order where the combination to open the safe, but before Clint would start a plan to open it, she went away. When escaping from New York, she was tracked down by Black Widow (who saw her when she arrived to the Avengers Mansion), revealing her real name: Darlene Penelope Wright. Widow made Penny explain her situation with Clint, and then let her go. As she left, Penny asked Natasha to take care of him. Penny returned to New York at the same time the Tracksuit Mafia raided Barton's building. She opened the safe, which contained real estate documents of importance to the Tracksuits. After Barton and Bishop subdued Tracksuit leader Ivan and the mercenary known as the Clown, she left the country once again.

darmo.name: Darmo
darmo.species: Spyrican mutated via exposure to cosmic rays
darmo.origin: Darmo was a member of the inner council of the Overseer, the patriarch of the planet Spyre. When four explorers from Earth attempted to reach Spyre but they had their rocket ship scuttled by a cosmic ray storm that gave them powers, becoming the Fantastic Four, the Overseer dreaded the threat they could pose if they were to resume their original mission now that they had powers. To this end, the Overseer decided to harness cosmic rays himself and give powers to volunteering Spyricans in hopes to combat the Fantastic Four if they were ever to arrive. Darmo was one of the first to subject himself to the Overseer's procedure. His arms were replaced by metal that he could shape-shift on command, and he adopted the identity of Sidearm. Along with other few superpowered Spyricans, Darmo joined the Unparalleled to become one of Spyre's protectors. One of Sidearm's teammates was his own daughter, Kaila, who gained avian-related abilities and adopted the name of Sky. Over a decade after their initial and failed attempt to reach Spyre, the Fantastic Four sought to complete their original mission. When they approached Spyre, the Overseer warned the Unparalleled of their arrival. The team intercepted the explorers and subdued them, but the Fantastic Four managed to establish that they meant no harm. However, when Mister Fantastic deduced that the Overseer had been secretly responsible for tampering the intensity of the cosmic ray storm that bestowed the Fantastic Four their powers, the Overseer ordered the Unparalleled to kill the visitors. After Mister Fantastic and the Invisible Woman slipped away, Sidearm was one of the Unparalleled deployed to the streets of Hightown to defuse a rebellion from the Monster Mob, the outcasts of Spyre who had been banished from society due to the Overseer's cosmic ray exposure turning them into monsters. Once Mister Fantastic exposed the Overseer's secret role in the creation of the Fantastic Four, making him responsible for the very threat the Spyricans feared, The Thing confronted the Overseer at the Tower of Over-Site, causing its collapse. The Unparalleled, the Monster Mob and the Fantastic Four joined forces to contain the falling debris. After the Unparalleled and the Fantastic Four made peace, Mister Fantastic shared with the Spyricans a cure to temporary revert cosmic ray mutates back to normal, which helped welcome the Monster Mob back into society. Despite his powers not affecting most of his appearance, Sidearm decided to undergo this procedure so that he could touch his loved ones with his real hands again, having also acknowledged that he was no different than the Monster Mob and vice versa. Later, the Unparalleled bid the Fantastic Four farewell as they prepared to return to Earth accompanied by Sky.

darnell wade.name: Darnell Wade
darnell wade.origin: Darnell Wade was born in Brooklyn and raised in multiple foster homes. Being passed from one home to another, Darnell took comfort in reading about the many superheroes based in New York. In his mid-20s, while working days at a secondhand clothing store, Darnell began moonlighting as Shade, a drag queen inspired by New York superheroes. With his best friend, Spillin' Tea-yana Taylor, Shade hosted a lip-sync night it Astoria. However, Shade's real ambition was to be the star of a drag queen competition show. Unfortunately, when Tea was selected as a drag competition contestant, she snubbed Shade on national television, ending their friendship and leaving Shade with nothing but an apartment with the electricity turned off and a desire to disappear. At that moment, Shade's mutant powers manifested, allowing him to control Darkforce energy to teleport himself and others. Excited by his new powers, Shade agreed to emcee New York's first Mutant Pride Parade. He also helped the X-Men fend off Mister Sinister's mutant-Iceman-golems. Later, using his powers, Darnell went on a "shopping spree" with a friend that ended when the police arrived, Darnell losing his friend while he escaped through the Darkforce. Vowing to now only use his powers to bring light and joy into the world, Darnell has rebranded his drag/hero persona as Darkveil. Darkveil was next seen emceeing at Java A Go-Go during Iceman's birthday celebration.

darrel daniel.name: Darrel Daniel
darrel daniel.origin: Darrel Daniel was the son of millionaire Milo Daniel. Darrel was a playful child and loved to have fun and make people laugh, but was discouraged by his father. He struggled to make friends as most of the children resented his wealth. At age sixteen Darrel's father died. Darrel during the funeral burst out laughing when he saw his father's body as the mortician was the only person that could put a smile on his father's face. This disgusted Zoe Daniel, his mother, who took him to a psychiatrist, Dr. Laslo Schact. When Darrel Daniel turned nineteen, he witnessed a traumatic event on TV. After that he decided that the world needed more laughter. Darrel Daniel met with Garvey, an owner of a carnival and tried to join and become a clown. Garvey, with hopes to get hold of Darrel's money, gave him a job and assigned Ayla Prentiss to teach him the craft. Darrel was a successful clown for a few years, and his feelings for Ayla Prentiss grew. Dr. Ted Sallis and Ellen Brandt visited Garvey's Carnival during this time. Many years later Darrel overheard Garvey and Ayla Prentiss talking about his money which destroyed him. He believed Ayla Prentiss was using him to get a hold of his fortune. He changed the style of his act to reflect his new mood, using skulls and serpents in his show. This frightened the audience, so Darrel ran away from the carnival. Darrel was driven to Man-Thing's swamp, where he shot himself in the head. Darrel's spirit emerged from his body, and the Critics, an extra-dimensional tribunal, informed him his soul must be judged according to an artistic retelling of his life's story. During this time the Man-Thing found Darrel's corpse, and started to dig a grave for it. Ayla Prentiss went looking for him with the help of Richard Rory and Ruth Hart. Darrel's spirit led them to Man-Thing and his body. Darrel's spirit also lured Garvey and Tragg to the swamp. When his old friends were assembled Darrel's spirit manifested again telling them they would help his soul find peace by re-enacting his life story for the Critics. The three then began their judgement on his soul. His life was neither morally or artistically worthwhile and none of the critics wished him to enter Heaven, Hell, or the Realm Between. They decided that their only choice was to destroy his soul, sending it into the oblivion of nothingness. Richard Rory tried to defend Daniel after witnessing his life, but the Critics warned him that if he interfered, his soul would also be destroyed. Man-Thing tried to attack the critics, which was pointless. Ayla Prentiss in a moment of supreme sacrifice offered her soul instead. This great gesture humbled the Critics and they decided to let him enter the Kingdom of Heaven.

darrell campbell.name: Darrell Campbell
darrell campbell.origin: Darrell Campbell and his friend Christopher Taylor decided to vandalize the home at 616 Hickory Branch Lane, the residence of the synthezoid named Vision and his family. Before they headed out, they looked up on the Internet any potential slurs to call the robots, and they settled on "socket lovers." Darrell remained behind while Christopher sprayed "Go home, socket lovers" on the garage doors of the Visions' house with paint. Virginia phased her arm through the door, grabbed Christopher and violently slammed him into the door. Darrell was startled, and Virginia threatened him so he wouldn't run away.

darren bentley.name: Darren Bentley
darren bentley.origin: Darren Bentley was once a crimelord who was recruited by Cornelius van Lunt to become his Zodiac Cartel's Aquarius. The Cartel fought the Avengers and were all able to escape. Aquarius, along with Capricorn and Sagittarius, attempted to take back the Zodiac Key after Nick Fury from Scorpion. However, Aquarius, his allies, and several others were suddenly sucked into the Key and forced fight each other. Aquarius had to fight Madame Masque. Everyone was eventually released back into the outside world. Aquarius and his allies managed to escape after holding Madame Masque hostage. Aquarius and the rest of the Zodiac Cartel threatened to wipe out everyone in New York City born under the sign of Gemini with a so-called "Star-Blazer" device as a show of their powers, but Avengers destroyed the Star-Blazer. Angry over this loss, Aries convinced Aquarius along with Leo, Cancer, Libra, Pisces, Sagittarius, and the new Scorpion in a rebellion against van Lunt's leadership of the Cartel. When the Avengers arrived, van Lunt activated a trap that launched the rebellious Zodiac members and the Avengers into outer space. They eventually return to Earth, and the Avengers defeated both sides of the Zodiac Cartel. After getting out of prison, Bentley learned that he was dying from a rare lung condition and made a deal with the demon Slifer that enabled him to take on the appearance and attributes of any of the other twelve Zodiac members so he could take revenge on his enemies. Bentley was opposed by Ghost Rider and ultimately died when Slifer claimed his life and soul as payment.

darren cross.name: Darren Cross
darren cross.species: Human mutate powered by Pym Particles and using a Yellowjacket's Suit
darren cross.origin: ===Early Life=== Darren Cross was a self made millionaire, he created and headed his company, Cross Technological Enterprises, and made it a success to rival the top competitors. thumb|left|Darren Cross non-mutated ===Heart Condition=== However, Darren was diagnosed with a rare heart condition. He used his own technology to create an experimental nucleorganic pacemaker to save his life. Although a success, the nucleorganic pacemaker mutated Darren's body to and gave him superhuman abilities. A side-effect of the mutation was that Darren would quickly overuse and burn out his heart. Multiple heart transplants were performed, but each heart was removed when overused. Desperate, he kidnapped heart surgeon Dr. Erica Sondheim to replace his damaged heart. He also kidnapped 'donors' from slums. ===Ant-Man=== Ant-Man (Scott Lang), also looking for Doctor Sondheim to save the life of his daughter Cassie, attempted to rescue her. A battle between Darren and Ant-Man resulted in Darren burning out his heart and dying, Sondheim revealed that when Ant-Man interrupted the operation, she replaced Darren's old heart rather than placing a new one. Cross' company was then taken over by his son Augustine. ===Rebirth=== After his death, Darren's body was kept in cryogenic state, and Augustine became obsessed with bringing him back to life, and eventually forced Dr. Sondheim to help him. Augustine planned to used the heart of Cassie Lang, which could change size due to the exposure to Pym Particles, in order to replace his father's, as it could withstand the unique conditions. While Scott Lang infiltrated Cross Technological Enterprises to rescue his daughter, he came across a rebirthed Darren Cross. Darren engaged in combat against Ant-Man while the hero tried to buy time for Sondheim to transplant another heart into Cassie. Cross was ultimately forced to flee with his son when the Pym Particles now in his body caused him to shrink down. ===Yellowjacket=== After the Power Broker demonstrated his Hench phone application to Cross Technologies, Augustine enlisted the service of Ant-Man's employee Machinesmith to hack into the Power Broker's servers and create a copy of the app, which he called Lackey. In retaliation for banking on his idea, the Power Broker manipulated Stinger, Cassie Lang's new costumed identity, into infiltrating the Cross Technological Enterprises Facility to insert a virus into their servers. darren mitchell.name: Darren Mitchell
darren mitchell.origin: Darren has spent his life with the V-Battalion and is extremely loyal to them, but he also wants to see the world. Darren has assumed the mantle of his father and grandfather before him. The grandson of the original Human Top, Darren's powers skipped a generation, by passing his father, who had tried using mechanical means to simulate the powers of the Human Top, but eventually decided to serve the V-Battalion in a scientific capacity. Darren knows he has sacrificed a lot growing up in such an isolated environment, particularly his chance to see the world. Ameiko Sabuki's death greatly affected Darren, making him unsure if he wanted to remain with the V-Battalion. ===After M-Day=== His post-M-Day status is unknown. After the Civil War, he was listed as a potential recruit for the Initiative.
