david zahn.name: David Zahn
david zahn.origin: Dr. David Zhan was the scientist responsible for designing the advanced plasma-field prison that successfully contained the Absorbing Man beneath a secret facility hidden under an abandoned cemetery in New Jersey. Following the apparent suicide of prison employee Judy Laughton and a series of unexplained assaults involving members of the staff, Zhan concluded that Carl Creel had somehow developed the ability to project his consciousness into other people's minds. His warnings, however, were dismissed by Warden C.J. Johnson. Convinced that Creel's body was merely a conduit while his mind operated elsewhere, Zhan confronted the Absorbing Man inside his cell. Desperate to stop him, he temporarily deactivated the plasma field and attempted to shoot him, only to become possessed himself. Under Creel's control, Zhan shot one of the prison guards before the possession ended, leaving him horrified by what he had done while Johnson concealed the truth by altering the security footage. As Creel's influence spread beyond the prison walls, Zhan continued trying to convince Johnson that the villain's psychic abilities posed a catastrophic threat. His attempts to investigate further instead resulted in him being confined to his quarters, preventing him from warning outsiders or assisting Pamela Grayson when she contacted the prison seeking answers. When Bruce Banner, manipulated by the Absorbing Man, broke into the underground complex, Zhan escaped confinement and reached the central chamber as the Hulk and the restored Absorbing Man fought throughout the facility. During the chaos he was mortally wounded, but before dying he managed to leave a final clue by touching his forehead, silently indicating the true weakness of Creel's powers. Realizing the meaning of Zhan's final gesture, Pamela Grayson tricked the Absorbing Man into possessing the dead scientist's body. Because a corpse no longer possessed a living mind, Creel became trapped inside it while his own physical body disintegrated. Although Zhan sacrificed his life, his final act made possible the apparent defeat of the Absorbing Man.

davida devito.name: Davida DeVito
davida devito.species: Human, Mutate; Titania was given her superhuman strength by the Power Broker.
davida devito.origin: Along with Letha, Melissa Gold (then known as Screaming Mimi), and Poundcakes, Davida DeVito was one of the four original Grapplers, an all-female wrestling team who became notorious for their ringside antics and their outrageous personalities. However, the women never made the kind of money their male counterparts did. Titania, the leader of the team, was approached by an executive in charge of covert operations for the Roxxon Oil company and offered them the chance to make some serious money by infiltrating and destroying the government energy research facility Project Pegasus in partnership with Thundra. Titania was outfitted with special one-inch diameter discs containing explosives. They failed in their mission, however, and were jailed. When they were paroled, they found that the women's wrestling business had floundered without them, and they were forced to become full-time criminals to support themselves. DeVito and the other Grapplers clashed with the mutant superhero Dazzler when she was imprisoned with them in the female wing of the Ryker's Island prison for super-powered felons. Dazzler, however, managed to defeat the four wrestlers. When the Unlimited Class Wrestling Federation for superhumanly strong wrestlers was founded, the Grapplers' manager Auntie Freeze decided it should have a female division, and submitted the original Grapplers as well as her newer recruits for the Power Broker's strength augmentation treatment. Their involvement with the UCWF enabled the Grapplers to go straight for a time. DeVito, however, lost leadership of the Grapplers to one of the team's newer recruits, Battleaxe, in a bout. She was later killed while in the shower when the Scourge operative Caprice disguised as a fellow female wrestler, "Golddigger", fired an explosive bullet at her. Titania was one of the Scourge's victims who was resurrected by the criminal the Hood to serve in his gang of super villains, whose initial aim was to kill the Punisher. Titania took on the alternative name of Lascivious, however, because her former alias had since become more associated with the new Titania.

davis mutant.name: Davis (Mutant)
davis mutant.origin: Davis was a mutant who believed that Thor was trying to take over the Earth, and began a terrorist campaign against him, the Asgardians, and the clean power facilities that they had created in Ohio. He was captured by Carl Creel, the Absorbing Man, and taken before the Asgardians after his first attack. Thor explained to him that the Asgardians were only there to help, and Davis promised that he would not do it again. He then went to the other power facility that the Asgardians built, this time killing one of the Asgardian guards in the process. Enraged, Thor tasked Heimdall to track down Davis. They located him in the woods, where he had recorded himself setting Thor up claiming that he was flying overhead screaming that he was going to kill him. When Thor arrived, Davis lunged at Thor, and killed himself when he turned his mutant ability on himself, making it appear that Thor had killed him.

davis cameron.name: Davis Cameron
davis cameron.origin: Davis Cameron was just a normal Australian surfer until the X-Treme X-Men found him and his sister Heather and told them that they were really the children of a deceased Sydney crime-lord. Not knowing that these people were mutants, Davis became enamored of Storm, and managed to get in a dance with her before they were all attacked by Tong assassins. Heather revealed that she was a mutant, as did the X-Men, which Davis found very cool. When Lifeguard was subsequently abducted by the alien invader Shaitan as she attempted to rescue Gambit, Sage revealed to Davis that he was a latent mutant, and that his power could help find his sister. Davis allowed Sage to activate his latent powers so he could locate Heather and transport the team to her location. Davis helped the X-Men as they fought against the invasion, but his inexperience showed when he defended Rogue against Vargas, who wounded him badly. Unfortunately for Davis, while he was recovering, his sister underwent massive physical changes that revealed her Shi'ar heritage, making her unrecognizable to him. He rejected her when she came to see him and left the hospital as soon as he was able, telling her not to try to find him. Both Lifeguard and Thunderbird continued to search for him. Davis was depowered as a result of the Scarlet Witch during the M-Day crisis, and was presumably still sought by his sister and Thunderbird. Years later, somehow repowered, Slipstream was one of the numerous former X-Men reached out to and summoned by Marvel Girl to help fight a maddened fusion of X-Man and Legion. Davis later joined the mutant nation of Krakoa. He was seen helping fight off the Russian Armed Forces that attacked the island. When Krakoa was teleported out of our plane of existence to the White Hot Room, Slipstream elected to stay and was planning to get married, whereas his sister, Heather, had to leave to take care of their stepmother.

davis carter.name: Davis Carter
davis carter.origin: Davis Carter is a historical figure on Earth-5106 and is revered as a pioneer in space travel. Born in 1928 Carter grew up to be a brilliant scientist and inventor. According to historical records in early 1953, Carter had come up with a design for a rocket ship that was powered by "super-magnetism" that allowed for a rocket to reach escape velocity as well as travel through space through the power of magnetism. He approached Anthony Roshay, owner of the Two-World Aeronautics Corporation, for funding to help him build his ship but Roshay turned him down finding Carter's claims far too outlandish to consider. Undaunted, Carter collected the money he needed by getting loans from friends and family members and eventually built his first rocket, the Magno 1. On Thanksgiving Day of 1953, Carter launched his rocket to much fanfare and succeeded in travelling out to the outer reaches of the solar system. He eventually returned to Earth his ship crashed landed in a farmers field and Carter was killed on impact. The only record on hand have two conflicting years of death: It initially states that Carter died in 1953, while it later states that his date of death was May 4, 1959. Whatever the case, his expedition won the interest of Anthony Roshay and he ordered further development of Davis Carter's designs. By the year 2000 the planet Earth saw major advancements in space travel based on Carter's work.

davis harmon.name: Davis Harmon
davis harmon.origin: Davis Harmon was the young and ambitious CEO of , a firm based out of the nation of Aqiria. Upset with former employee and arms dealer, Parnell Jacobs, Harmon decided to apply pressure to Parnell's gun-running efforts by kidnapping his wife, Glenda Sandoval. Jacobs enlisted the aid of War Machine to free Sandoval, whereupon he flew to Aqiria and engaged Harmon's mercenaries in combat. Davis was undeterred by War Machine's presence however, citing that he was a "hero" and "heroes don't kill".

davos.name: Davos
davos.species: Immortal human cyborg with chi absorbing abilities.
davos.origin: ===Early Life=== Davos was the first son of Lei-Kung the Thunderer, a fearsome martial artist and trainer of the Iron Fist legacy from the city of K'un-Lun. In order to live up to his father's legacy he trained hard and knew that one day he would become one of the most powerful martial artists to leave K'un-Lun with the power of Iron Fist. ===Iron Fist=== However, there was one obstacle he had to overcome. He had to defeat the other person in line for the Iron Fist name: Wendell Rand-K'ai, son of Yu-Ti, August Personage in Jade and ruler of K'un-Lun. Davos proved unsuccessful in this attempt and was soundly beaten by Wendell. He refused to give up despite this beating but eventually Yu-Ti announced Wendell the winner which infuriated Davos who accused Yu-Ti of being biased towards his own son. Lei Kung told his son to stay silent and sent him away. Davos' pride and anger got the better of him and he went to challenge the dragon Shou-Lao in his cavern and gain the power of Iron Fist despite his loss. Shou-Lao scarred Davos over his left eye but Davos knew the secret to defeating the Dragon: to block the power of its heart with his body. However, the pain was too much and Davos soon succumbed to the Dragon's power. Lei Kung found his son defeated in the snow and took him back to the city. Yu-Ti then exiled Davos to Earth, stating that he could never return to K'un-Lun. Despite this, Wendell did not challenge Shou-Lao and also went to Earth. Tuan eventually died and Wendell's brother took his place and had a son named Daniel who would take the power of Iron Fist. It was here that Davos began plotting to kill Daniel and take the power of Iron Fist for himself. ===Danny Rand=== thumb|left|The Steel Serpent prepares to face the Iron Fist Davos attempted many times over the years to kill Daniel by absorbing the power of Shou-Lao. He allied himself with Joy and Ward Meachum to be able to close in on Rand. They watched the battle between Iron Fist and Radion on television, hoping he would survive so they could get their revenge. Joy asked Davos to investigate her uncle Ward, he complied as he agreed to work for them until he killed Danny Rand. Davos acted as Joy’s bodyguard during her meeting with Danny. When the Golden Tigers attacked the Meachum Building, he saved Joy Meachum instead of attacking Iron Fist despite her orders, telling her he would choose the time and place of Iron Fist's death himself. Davos confronted Ward threatening him to quit and disappear and leave Joy to run the company. He told her that his debt was paid in full and it was now time for his revenge. He attacked Iron Fist, he tried to absorb the power of Shou-Lao, but Iron Fist broke free weakened. Davos called his true name "Daniel Rand-K'ai", showing his knowledge of K'un-Lun. He walked away with a warning. He later found Danny trying to stop some criminal steal a shipment from Rand-Meachum, Inc. He attacked him and tried to absorb the power again but left him to absorb more of his power later. ===Spider-Man=== Davos later challenged Danny to combat under the laws of K'un-Lun, signed the Steel Serpent. In order to live up to his father's legacy he trained hard and knew that one day he would become one of the most powerful martial artists to leave K'un-Lun with the power of Iron Fist. ===Iron Fist=== However, there was one obstacle he had to overcome. He had to defeat the other person in line for the Iron Fist name: Wendell Rand-K'ai, son of Yu-Ti, August Personage in Jade and ruler of K'un-Lun. Davos proved unsuccessful in this attempt and was soundly beaten by Wendell. He refused to give up despite this beating but eventually Yu-Ti announced Wendell the winner which infuriated Davos who accused Yu-Ti of being biased towards his own son. Lei Kung told his son to stay silent and sent him away. Davos' pride and anger got the better of him and he went to challenge the dragon Shou-Lao in his cavern and gain the power of Iron Fist despite his loss. Shou-Lao scarred Davos over his left eye but Davos knew the secret to defeating the Dragon: to block the power of its heart with his body. However, the pain was too much and Davos soon succumbed to the Dragon's power. Lei Kung found his son defeated in the snow and took him back to the city. Yu-Ti then exiled Davos to Earth, stating that he could never return to K'un-Lun. Despite this, Wendell did not challenge Shou-Lao and also went to Earth. Tuan eventually died and Wendell's brother took his place and had a son named Daniel who would take the power of Iron Fist. When the Golden Tigers attacked the Meachum Building, he saved Joy Meachum instead of attacking Iron Fist despite her orders, telling her he would choose the time and place of Iron Fist's death himself. Davos confronted Ward threatening him to quit and disappear and leave Joy to run the company. He told her that his debt was paid in full and it was now time for his revenge. He attacked Iron Fist, he tried to absorb the power of Shou-Lao, but Iron Fist broke free weakened. Davos called his true name "Daniel Rand-K'ai", showing his knowledge of K'un-Lun. He walked away with a warning. He later found Danny trying to stop some criminal steal a shipment from Rand-Meachum, Inc. The power however began to build up in Davos' body, turning against him. davy jones.name: Davy Jones
davy jones.origin: ===19th century=== Sad with residing in his little old house under the ocean without companions, Davy Jones fabricated a pontoon to search for organization in the ocean. It was a warm spring day in 1825 when Davy Jones met a privateer transport and was invited on board by Captain Silas Redmond and his seconds-in-order, Hooker and Creech. Davy Jones didn't support privateers without a doubt, yet stayed on board in any case. Before very long, every time the privateers attempted to attack or pursue prey, the weather conditions changed abruptly tempests, winds and flows saved different boats, striking just against Redmond's boat; when Redmond or his men undermined Jones for being the one liable for this dark enchantment, thunderclaps and mists paid all due respects to their statements. At long last Redmond couldn't bear it any longer he drew his cutlass against Jones, yet a tropical storm out of nowhere released its rage on the privateer transport. The majority of the group got away from in rafts, however the commander needed to stay on his boat. Davy Jones would have rather not hurt anybody, so he saved Redmond, Hooker and Creech by taking them to his home under the ocean; Jones then played a card game with his new friends. ===20th century=== In the twentieth Century, Davy Jones and his facial hair were popular among mariners all around the world they summoned him when they saw extraordinary things like a Roc or a phantom ship. ====World War I==== A couple of years before the start of World War I, during a wild and hazardous ocean storm around evening time, a mariner was frightened that every one of them would go down to Davy Jones's Locker. ====World War II==== Namor the Sub-Mariner was close to Grayson Island, close to the southern coast of the US, when he saved a man who was suffocating. Namor himself said that he saved the man "from an outing to Davy Jones's Locker". Davy Jones' numerous endeavours to sink the Nancy, a little freight boat captained by Dick Rogers, were thwarted by the Olympian god Neptune himself. ====1950's==== In the form of a grizzled old mariner, Davy Jones went to a shoreline lodging, where he met the colleague of Catherine Crane, a lovely youthful gold-digger. Catherine faked heartfelt premium in the affluent elderly person, whom she knew exclusively as "David," yet plotted to kill him for his cash. Afterward, Catherine joined David on board his boat so he could take her to his storage, where all his abundance was covered up; they were miles from land when they were trapped in an irate tempest. As he uncovered his last name to her, David snatched Catherine, hopped over the edge, and hauled her down to his locker. Thief Harry Spain's air hose got cut during a jump. In a clear dream he awakened before Davey Jones and was proposed to plunk down on a seat by Davey Jones himself. When Harry heard his slippery accomplice Jake, whom Harry accepted to have cut his air hose, Jake didn't sit down and on second thought went after Jake. Minutes after the fact Harry stirred on board his rescue vessel for genuine on the grounds that Jake had pulled him up, getting away from Davey Jones' storage all the while. Jake guaranteed that Harry's air hose likely got cut on a sharp stone or coral. Harry didn't trust Jake and cut him to death. Harry was captured by the coast monitor. Harry was before long condemned to death for the homicide of Jake and was wound up waiting for capital punishment. At the point when it was the ideal opportunity for Harry to sit down on the hot seat, the jail's superintendent bowed before Davey Jones, who at last turned into the man to pull the switch to execute Harry Spain. This time Harry couldn't get away from Davey Jones. Three men adrift on the ocean with no hope of survival; Joseph Rusak, Theodore Standish, and Herbert Slade met a devil claiming to be Davy Jones, and they were offered a contract to ensure their survival: We three Joseph Rusak, Theodore Standish, and Herbert Slade, adrift in a lifeboat and doomed to death, do for the right to live for a thousand years, hereby assign our souls to the devil, otherwise known as Lucifer, Beelzebub, Satan, Elimi, Astaroth, and Davy Jones. In faith where we affix our names below" Joseph Rusak was the only one not to sign the contract, and he was saved by a passing ship; his two companions disappeared from the life-raft, never to be seen again. Davy Jones had assembled limitless fortunes in his storage submerged. He turned into a money manager in the USA and carried on with an apparently ordinary existence. At some point, criminal Freddy Sykes heard Davy Jones discussing his riches, which he kept in a storage. Sykes followed Jones, and when they were distant from everyone else in the mist on the docks, Sykes took out his handgun and compromised Jones. dawn burnside.name: Dawn Burnside
dawn burnside.origin: left|thumb|Dawn Burnside Dawn was a wet engineer who hacked and snaked data from Hollowpoint for Alchemax. As soon as Jac, her boss and connection to Alchemax, was replaced, Dawn immediately became wanted by the police force of Hollowpoint, the Leatherdogs. Having been cornered, Dawn used the new technology invented by her, replacing her blood with a kind of liquid metal, so that her body could become a highly adaptable armor. In her new capacity as Steel Rain, Dawn fought against the Leatherdogs and then hunted and killed the manager who had replaced and therefore killed Jac, Payne Northedge, and also a gang of criminals hired by Northedge and led by the cyborg Saint Carcrash.

dawn fury.name: Dawn Fury
dawn fury.origin: Dawn Fury is the sister of Nick and Jake Fury, and the youngest of them, being four years younger than Jake. She thankfully had limited contact with her brothers’ adventurous lives, although she was drawn into events, being kidnapped and used by Colonel Klaue and other Nazi foreign agents when Nick was on a furlough in New York City. She turned up alive in modern times, attending Nick’s funeral after he was apparently assassinated by the Punisher, although the presence of the Hulk, who was also involved in her brother’s apparent death, nearly turned the entire event into a circus. Her current whereabouts and activities are unknown.

Her current whereabouts and activities are unknown.

dawn greenwood light form.name: Dawn Greenwood (Light-Form)
dawn greenwood light form.origin: During their journey exploring the universe, the Silver Surfer and his companion Dawn Greenwood visited the planet Inkandessa 4, populated mostly by beings of solid light known as Light-Forms. For the Light-Forms, it was ethically unacceptable to have on their planet a creature that processed matter and excreted waste such as Dawn. When she requested to use a restroom, they instead took her to their facilities, where they scanned her essence into a Holo-Pod and created a holographic duplicate of her to take her place while the body of the original Dawn was delivered to Countess Crankshaft's farm to be destroyed. thumb|left|Dawn's body temporarily distorted Dawn's Light-Form duplicate was returned to the Surfer, with no idea that she was no longer a being of flesh and bone. The Light-Forms proceeded to show around Dawn and the Surfer, and had them enjoy their culture. At a ball, the Surfer had his very first dance with Dawn, with either Dawn. While visiting a zoo, the hologram of one of the animals glitched out and phased through its cage. It was then that one Life-Form explained not only the nature and origin of his species, but also that Dawn had been replaced with a Life-Form herself. When the Light-Forms refused to give the Surfer the location of Countess Crankshaft's farm, he used his Power Cosmic to temporarily disrupt all light constructs on the planet to bypass its holographic shield. Using the Surfer's surfboard, Dawn made haste to reach the farm and managed to save the body of the original at the last second. The Silver Surfer then brought her back to life. The original Dawn initially suggested to "switch off" her Light-Form duplicate before she and the Surfer left the planet, but later apologized, even though she was still disgruntled with the fact she was no longer unique. Countess Crankshaft subsequently revealed that the Light-Form Dawn had to stay on Inkandessa 4 and relatively close to the Great Machine that projected all Light-Forms in order to survive. She bid the Surfer, his board, and the real Dawn farewell, noticing that even though she was the Dawn that had to stay, she would always be the Dawn with whom the Surfer danced first. Once the Surfer and the real Dawn left, the other Light-Forms offered Dawn to show her around her new homeworld. Following the death of the original Dawn Greenwood, the Silver Surfer returned to Inkandessa 4 to reunite the Holo Dawn with Light-Form duplicates of the rest of her family and even himself.

dawn middlebury.name: Dawn Middlebury
dawn middlebury.origin: Vavavoom was a member of the Grapplers, the female division of the Unlimited Class Wrestling Federation. Like the other Grapplers, Vavavoom underwent the strength-augmentation process of the Power Broker, boosting her strength and durability to superhuman levels. Vavavooom clashed with the Thing when the Grapplers' leader Titania was killed by her teammate Gold Digger, secretly a member of the agents known as Scourge of the Underworld, and the Thing was suspected of the killing by the Grapplers. The fight was broken up by Sharon Ventura, who proved the Thing's innocence. Vavavoom has not been seen since, and her subsequent activities are unknown.

dawn revere.name: Dawn Revere
dawn revere.origin: Dawn Revere grew up on Earth-5106, a world where rocket technology and space exploration bloomed in the 1950s. Her father was Bennett "Blast" Revere a famous rocket pilot who eventually became the chief of the Galaxy organization and commander of the Space Squadron. She and her old brother Edgar were raised alone by their father after her mother Wanda died of a broken heart. By the year 2000 Dawn was engaged to Space Squadron member Jet Dixon, however her father forbade them to marry as he did not want Dawn to suffer the same fate as her mother from the stress caused by Jet's career. Despite this, Dawn remained defiant and remained committed to Jet in the hopes that her father would one day change his mind and allow them to get married. Jet eventually was promoted to the ranks of field-commander of Space Squadron much to the chagrin of her brother Edgar. Following Jet's promotion, he took Dawn to the planet Mercury to see the memorial of his great-grandfather John Dixon and told her the story of how he saved the Earth from destruction in 1955. After returning to Earth, Martians of the warrior VDBN tribe arrived on Earth to learn the ways of peace. However their leader Mxxptrm soon became violent toward Jet when he became jealous of his relationship with Dawn. Jet easily defeated Mxxptrm in combat but spared his life. Unable to cope with this act of mercy, Mxxptrm kidnapped Dawn, her father and the delegates of Galaxy who further convinced Mxxptrm and his people to give up their violent ways. Mxxptrm returned them to Earth and then accepted admission into the Space Squadron. Later while Jet was on a mission to solve an explosion of anarchy on the planet Mercury, Dawn was present when her brother attempted to convince the other members of the Galaxy council to go to war against Mercury. Dawn and her father helped maintain calm among the council until Jet returned with his mission successful. Later while Jet was on a mission on Saturn battling the Octopus-Men, Dawn caught her brother Edgar trying to sabotage the Destasto-Ray device that was relaying distress call from Jet. She succeeded in stopping Edgar and calling in the assistance Jet needed to defeat the creatures. Later, Dawn and Jet once more petitioned Bennett to allow them to marry but were once more denied. Shortly thereafter Dawn, her father, and the Galaxy council became prisoners of the interplanetary criminal known as Boz who subdued the entire federation with tentacles under his control. Attracted to Dawn, Boz also tried to force her to be his queen, but Boz was ultimately killed by Jet and the Space Squadron, freeing Dawn and the others in the process.

dawn star.name: Dawn Star
dawn star.origin: Dawn Star was a Comanche princess who lived during the days of the American Frontier. She was born in 1848. In her adulthood she met and fell in love with a Caucasian lawyer named Cory Rand and the pair soon married. However, due to the social stigmas of the time, Rand lost his job as a lawyer due to his marriage. Undaunted, Cory and his new bride decided to start a ranch together and live off the land where they had many happy years together. Soon Dawn Star gave birth to their son, who grew up to be the outlaw hero known as the Ringo Kid, however Dawn Star would not live to see this happen. One day in 1868, Cory Rand killed Shad Rathburn while defending his son in town, becoming an outlaw in the process. Rathburn's men got revenge by burning down the Rand family ranch, and Dawn Star was killed in the fire. Cory was soon captured by Rathburn's gang but rescued by his son who became an outlaw himself by killing all of Rathburn's men.

dawn starr.name: Dawn Starr
dawn starr.origin: Dawn Starr was invited by Flash Thompson and Sha Shan Nguyen to be Peter Parker's date for the evening. Peter was smitten with Dawn, but found out that she was going to be one of his students and he found it unethical to date her. Peter reconsidered the next day, but in the evening found Dawn rummaging through his files at Empire State University. He switched into his Spider-Man costume and confronted her. Dawn attempted to cover saying that she was waiting for Peter, but Peter knew and outed her. Dawn was actually after her science exam, which she wanted from Peter. She leaves in tears never to be seen again.

daydra.name: Daydra
daydra.origin: thumb|left|Daydra Daydra was the designated Princess of the Sagittarians. When she was young, the Galaxy Master came to her world, ravaging and enslaving it. In the following years, the Galaxy Master returned to Daydra's home world and threatened it again, but this time, he had the Abomination on his side to help him. Daydra gathered three interstellar warriors: Amphibian, Torgo, and Dark-Crawler, and called them the Hulk-Hunters. Their first task was sending them to Earth to enlist the aid of the Hulk, one of Earth's champions she had heard about, to fight on her behalf against the Abomination and the Galaxy Master.

daydream.name: Daydream
daydream.species: Human/Demon hybridCategory:Human/Demon Hybrids of Nightmare and Betty Ross
daydream.origin: Daydream was conceived when Nightmare forced himself on Betty Ross in a dream while she slept, as part of a long term revenge plot against the Hulk. Nightmare attempted to cultivate a hatred for humans and humanity in his daughter. Putting her into an amnesiac state, Nightmare relocated Daydream to Earth where she adopted the name Gwen. Gwen went on to become a singer and eventually associated with a man named Ripley. Falling in love with Ripley earned her father's ire; he attacked her in the form of Thunderbolt Ross. The Hulk broke through multiple levels of illusions, which Gwen revealed to be have been created by Nightmare. Fed up with the games, the Hulk decided to leave. Nightmare taunted him, revealing that the woman he "fathered" Gwen with was none other than Betty Ross. The Hulk attacked him, taking his horse and riding away across the sea. Gwen teleported herself and Ripley away, wanting to "live happily ever after."

daystar spaceknight.name: Daystar (Spaceknight)
daystar spaceknight.origin: Daystar was the leader of the Galadorian envoy sent to the Kree homeworld Hala. Peter Quill (Star-Lord) had arranged for a demonstration of a new leading edge Galadorian defense program called "A-ware" to upgrade the Kree War-Net. The Spaceknights were delivered to Hala by a Galadorian cruiser and proceeded to the planet to provide a demonstration of the new software. Once uploaded to the Kree systems, an apparent incompatibility arose causing the Kree defenses to go out of control. Quill asks Daystar remove the programming from the War-net but is rebuffed by the Spaceknight who states there is no incompatibility. Quill realizes they have been betrayed and then attempts to have the systems purged and rebooted but is stopped by Daystar who crushes the communicator in Quill's hand. It is then that a 'techno-mesh' begins go exude from the visors of the spaceknight envoy and soon it is learned that the Spaceknights were under the control of the Phalanx. It is later learned by the High Evolutionary that soon after the Ultron/Phalanx emerged, they attacked the Kree. After quickly defeating the Kree and having 'selected' Korath that a nearby squadron of Spaceknights answered the Kree distress call where they presumably became infected. When the Guardians of the Galaxy tried to infiltrate Ultron's base, Quill was captured. However, Mantis protected his mind from Ultron, sensing the telepath, Ultron sent Daystar to kill her, but was interrupted by Bug who managed to beat Daystar and stab him in the chest. However, due to Daystar's cyborg physiology, it did not kill him, and he attempted to strangle Bug. Before he could succeed, he was shot in the head by Rocket Raccoon.

dea sea.name: Dea-Sea
dea sea.origin: After the disappearance of half of the Kree Empire population due to the event of the Infinity Gauntlet, the Captain Dea-Sea was placed on red alert with the Kree fleet assuming that such outrage reeked of Skrull treachery. Years later, after Reed Richard's recreation of the multiverse led to the discovery of the new Infinity Stones, the newly anointed Extreme Intelligence dispatched the Kree Imperial Fleet to the far reaches of space in search of them. Captain Dea-Sea discovered a strange energy signature in The Arcturus System, but before he could investigate further, a patrol of Badoon warships tracking the same energy attacked. Outgunned, Dea-Sea attempted to call a retreat, when the Badoon were wiped out by the appearance of The Dark Starhawk. Dea-Sea assumed the new Starhawk was an ally, and reached out to thank him for the assistance, but the Starhawk revealed that the only reason he hadn't destroyed the Kree vessel is because he thought it was a cooler looking ship than the Badoon's. Starhawk commandeered the ship for the Fraternity of Raptors and set course for Earth, leaving the fate of Captain Dea-Sea and his crew unknown.

deacon.name: Deacon
deacon.species: Human transformed into a Magical Being
deacon.origin: The Deacon was a serial killer who believed that he was chosen by God to kill the sinners of the world, but in fact he was chosen by Zadkiel. Eventually, he was captured and put in prison. When Johnny Blaze learned the truth of his origin, he went to the prison the Deacon was held in to talk to a priest that was being held there for murder. One of the prison guards let Deacon out of his cell and gave him two large knives and the Stone Serum, giving him super strength. He fought Ghost Rider and was winning until they entered the chapel, and Blaze beat him with a bible. Escaping from prison, he slaughtered the order of nuns that raised Caretaker (Sara), and continued to act as an agent of Zadkiel. When the Ghost Riders went to heaven through the gate guarded by the Gun Nuns, the Deacon showed up and slaughtered the nuns. Before he could kill the last one, Sara arrived. The two fought, and Sara slashed his back, severing his spine and crippling him. He was later seen in a hospital bed with the Orb. At some point, Deacon died and his soul was sent to Hell, becoming a demon. When Blaze became the King of Hell, Deacon was one of the demons who attempted to usurp the Devil's Throne from him.

deacon frost.name: Deacon Frost
deacon frost.origin: ===Early Life=== Deacon Frost was a scientist looking for the key to immortality. For one of his experiments, he kidnapped Ilsa, a young woman, in order to inject her with the blood of a recently killed vampire. Ilsa's fiancé broke into the lab and in the resulting scuffle, Frost accidentally was injected with the blood himself. The result was that Frost became a vampire but due to the unusual method of his becoming a vampire, he was endowed with a unique characteristic. Anyone he turned into a vampire would generate a doppelgänger. He could create an infinite number of doppelgängers by biting each doppelgänger, and they would all be under his mental control. ===Creating Blade=== Eric Brooks, the man later known as Blade, was born Soho, London, in 1929. His father, Lucas Cross, a member of the secret society the Order of Tyrana, sent his pregnant wife Vanessa Brooks to England before he was taken prisoner in Latveria. Experiencing labor complications, Tara was forced to seek a doctor's assistance. The doctor, Deacon Frost feasted on the woman as she gave birth, passing on a series of enzymes that altered her baby. The enzymes entered the infant's bloodstream, transforming him into a Dhampir - a being tainted by a vampire's kiss, but not converted; in other words half-man, half-vampire. Frost was driven away before he could slay the child, but Tara perished, leaving the orphaned Eric Brooks to be raised at Madame Vanity's brothel. ===Dracula=== Frost intended to use his doppelgänger ability to contend for the position of Lord of Vampires, a position that was presently owned by Dracula. It was also Frost who turned Hannibal King into a vampire. Blade and King, while initially distrusting each other, eventually teamed up to fight Frost's Blade Doppelgänger. The Blade Doppelganger and King crashed into Dracula's party where Deacon Frost was among the crowd, watching eagerly as this is all part of his ongoing plan. Furious at "Blade's" interruption of his party, Dracula attacked and was shocked to find his longtime vampire hunter foe to now be vampire himself. "Blade" appeared to have the upper hand when he stabbed Dracula in the back with one of his wooden daggers. However, Dracula turned around, and mocked the fake Blade's inferior skill to the original as he impaled the vampire doppelgänger in the chest with a stake, killing him. ===Resurrection=== Many years later, Blade encountered a vampire that called itself Deacon Frost. This vampire had a different appearance and personality to the original Frost, and was later identified as being a doppelgänger. The doppelgänger attempted to summon a powerful demon, only to be devoured by it. Later in New Orleans, Deacon Frost encountered Blade yet again. He also confirmed that their previous encounter was indeed an imposter, as Blade suspected, created using science and magic. Blade and King, with the help of Brother Voodoo, foiled Frost's attempt to gain control of Garwood Industries through Donna Garth (daughter of Simon Garth, the so-called Living Zombie). Frost escaped this encounter vowing revenge. ===Death, Return, and Death=== More recently, Frost appeared at the summons of Dracula to defend the Lord of Vampires as he underwent a magical ritual, only to be staked by Blade. Frost returned under Mephisto's orders to make Falcon suffer for his recent defeat of Blackheart. However, his plan was foiled by the team-up of Falcon, Misty Knight, and Blade, and he was ultimately killed by Redwing piercing through his heart, returning him to Hell and displeased Mephisto.

dead aim.name: Dead Aim
dead aim.origin: Dead Aim was ordered by his master to kill the Foreigner. Dead Aim found Swift-1 on a roof. Swift-1 had just failed the mission to kill the Foreigner, so Dead Aim killed him without mercy. Then he found some residual footprints of the Foreigner, communicated via radio to his master, and followed his target to Manhattan. He found the Foreigner and Spider-Man in Central Park and shot a ray on the Foreigner who collapsed. Then he was attacked by Spider-Man. Dead Aim tried to shoot at Spider-Man but kept missing him and was hit by a Foreigner shot, without result. The two fled and Dead Aim didn't follow them. He however scanned the transmissions arriving to the Foreigner, found the one coming from the Foreigner's satellite, decoded the message, and transmitted it to his master who took control of the satellite. Later, Dead Aim, Battle Scar, and Warzone waited for the Foreigner near their secret base (an abandoned subway station). They attacked Spider-Man and the Foreigner, and after that the master caused the Satellite to explode, so that the Foreigner lost his super-powers. Dead Aim's visor was covered by Spider-Man's web, but his visor was protected, so the trick didn't work, and he was able to grab Spider-Man and crush him his deadly super-strength. Spider-Man hit him in the head and broke the visor, blinding Dead Aim who started to blast rays where he heard the Foreigner's voice, but almost struck his allies. At one point, they all noticed the Satellite falling down in the direction of the Foreigner. Dead Aim wanted to run away, but the Foreigner said that the satellite was like an atomic bomb, so the killers didn't move. Dead Aim understood that the master considered them to be expendable. Spider-Man succeeded in disconnecting the nuclear box, causing the satellite to explode before touching the ground. The explosion was strong enough to knock Dead Aim and his allies out. Some minutes after, the NYPD arrested the three killers.

deadbolt.name: Deadbolt
deadbolt.origin: Deadbolt was a member of the Dark Riders during its formation by the villain Genesis. Wolverine used Spyne's tail to kill him. Deadbolt, along with a few other Dark Riders, were resurrected by Selene by the Transmode Virus. Later, Deadbolt and the Dark Riders resurfaced and began hunting down mutant healers. This led to a battle between the Riders and Magneto's X-Men. Magneto managed to defeat the Dark Riders, and killed all of them by detonating explosives around them.

deadeye dick.name: Deadeye Dick
deadeye dick.origin: Deadeye Dick was a part of a mercenary team known as the Scourge who was tasked to help Deadpool capture the mutant, Wolverine for their benefactor the Administrator. After destroying a pub where Logan was located, Deadeye and the others confronted him in a full on battle which ended when the Administrator showed up and knocked Wolverine unconscious. After some time had past, the interdimensional traveler Major X arrived at Cape Elizabeth in Maine, where he was confronted by Deadeye Dick and the rest of the Scourge under the leadership of Dreadpool. But Deadeye didn't last long as the Major made quick work of them with Dreadpool the last one standing.
